slides.content:
须知主乃独一真神，
祂能毁灭，也能创建。

Know that the Lord is God alone;
He can create, and He destroy.

世人犹如亡羊迷途， 
主亲找回，并施慰抚。
And when like wandering 
sheep we strayed,
He brought us to His fold again.

全地居民语言万千， 
异口颂扬上达主前。
And earth, with her ten thousand tongues, Shall fill His courts with sounding praise.

主名广传远达天边， 
主爱广被永不变迁; 
Wide as the world is His command
Vast as Eternity His love

时间纵然中止向前，
神圣真理如石常坚。
Firm as a rock His truth shall stand,
When rolling years shall cease to move.

圣哉,圣哉,圣哉
全权之神明
清晨我众歌声穿云上达至尊
Holy, holy, holy
Lord God Almighty
Early in the morning 
our song shall rise to Thee

圣哉,圣哉,圣哉
主有慈悲权能
荣耀与赞美,归三一真神

merciful and mighty
God in three Persons
blessed Trinity

Holy, holy, holy
 Angels adore Thee
Casting down their golden crowns 
around the glassy sea

千万天军叩拜
同声颂主圣名
昔在而今在,永在亿万春

and evermore shalt be

黑暗蔽圣明
世人不能眼见我主无上威荣;
Holy, holy, holy 
though the darkness hide Thee

Thy glory may not see

惟有主为至善
惟有主为至尊
至仁又至圣,全智全能神
Only Thou art holy 
there is none beside Thee
Perfect in power, in love, and purity

圣哉，圣哉，圣哉！ 
全能大主宰！ 
海天云山酬和吾众赞美歌声; 
 Holy, Holy, Holy!
 Lord God Almighty!
All Thy works shall praise Thy name, 
in earth and sky and sea;

圣哉，圣哉，圣哉！ 
慈悲与全能， 
荣耀与赞美，归三一真神！

Holy, Holy, Holy! 
merciful and mighty,
God in three persons, blessed Trinity!

崇拜真神
圣堂中肃穆而庄严
万民齐屈膝  荣耀被诸天
O worship the Lord 
In the beauty of holiness
Bow down before Him
His glory proclaim

众生皆听命
心香一瓣达神前
俯伏崇拜主 圣名扬无边
With gold of obedience
And incense of lowliness
Kneel and adore Him
The Lord is His name

崇拜真神
卸下我重担与艰辛
神知人类苦 ,慈爱拯万民
Low at His feet 
Lay thy burden of carefulness
High on His heart 
He will bear it for thee

有求均垂允
多方慰藉伤心人
愿随主领导 凡事必能成
Comfort thy sorrows
And answer thy prayerfulness
Guiding thy steps
As may best for thee be

崇拜真神
心灵中疑惧两皆休
不虞家贫乏 无为己筹谋
Fear not to enter
His courts in the slenderness
Of the poor wealth
Thou wouldst reckon as thine

惟求信心坚
为人和爱且温柔
神恩自眷顾 接纳我祈求
Truth in its beauty
And love in its tenderness
These are the offerings 
To lay on His shrine

崇拜真神
在主前敬拜须虔诚
天父必悦纳  耶稣至宝名
These, though we bring them
in trembling and fearfulness
He will accept 
For the name that is dear

昨日伤心泪
今朝化为真欢欣
坚信我所望  从此得安宁
Mornings of joy 
give for evenings of tearfulness
Trust for our trembling
And hope for our fear

我等同心聚集 恳求主赐宏恩

The Lord's blessing

His will to make known

赞美上帝圣名 他不忘其民

cease from distressing

同得荣耀自由 永赞主圣名

escape tribulation
Thy name be ever praised
O Lord, make us free

赞美上主,全能真神
宇宙万有君王, 我灵颂主
因主永远是你救赎健康
Praise to the Lord, the Almighty
the King of creation
O my soul, praise Him, 
for He is thy health and salvation

弟兄姐妹,如今来到主圣堂
欢然向主恭敬赞扬
All ye who hear
now to His temple draw near

赞美上主,如此奇妙
统治世间万物，展开恩翼,

Praise to the Lord, Who o'er all things
so wondrously reigneth
Shieldeth thee under His wings
yea, so gently sustaineth

你岂不见,有求皆蒙主垂顾n主应允你,指示道途
Hast thou not seen
how thy desires e'er have been
Granted in what He ordaineth

赞美上主,扶你护你
使你工作顺利，上主福惠,
上主鸿恩，必天天追随你
Praise to the Lord, who doth prosper
thy work and defend thee

仔细思量,全能大主爱深长

All glory, laud, and honor, 
to thee, Redeemer, King, 
to whom the lips of children

无限尊荣与赞美,全归救赎大君
昔日儿童高声唱;和撒那归至尊

Thou art the King of Israel, 
thou David's royal Son, 
who in the Lord's name comest, 
the King and Blessed One.
主乃大卫之后裔,以色列民之王
奉父圣名来世上,当受万众赞扬.

The company of angels 
are praising thee on high, 
and we with all creation 
in chorus make reply.
天使天军无量数,在天赞美主名
受造众生与万物,在地同声响应

The people of the Hebrews 
with psalms before thee went; 
our prayer and praise and anthems 
before thee we present.
昔日希伯来民众,迎主欢拂棕枝
如今我众同呈献;赞美,
祈祷,颂词

To thee, before thy passion, 
they sang their hymns of praise; 
to thee, now high exalted, 
our melody we raise.
当年在主受难前,彼等口唱心和
如今救主在高天,我众谨献新歌

Thou didst accept their praises; 
accept the prayers we bring, 
who in all good delightest, 
thou good and gracious King.
慈悲恩主爱良善,昔日悦纳彼等
恳主如今也接受 我众赞美热忱

主恩广大深厚,崇高无可比,
祂有永恒妙爱,显示大胜利.
Broad and deep and glorious,
 As the heaven above,
Shines in might victorious 
His eternal love.

锦绣河山如画,丹青难绘描,
众生异口同赞,歌声穿云霄.
Everything rejoices 
in the mellow rays;
Earth's ten thousand voices 
swell the psalm of praise.

黑暗遮盖大地,幽暗蔽万民;
帘幕今已卷起,天父护我身.
And when clouds are drifting
 dark across the sky,
Then, the veil uplifting, 
father, be Thou nigh.

众光之光照我,直奔天国程,
主仍作我先导,永远不变更.
Light of light, shine o'er us 
on our pilgrim way,
Go Thou still before us 
to the endless day.

title_en: From All That Dwell Below the Skies (SDAH 23)

slides.content:
但愿天下千万生灵， 
齐声称颂造化至尊！
From all that dwell below the skies,
Let the Creator’s praise arise;

处处地方，人人舌上， 
高歌赞美救主圣名。
Let the Redeemer’s Name be sung,
Through every land, by every tongue.

当知主是独一真神， 
不藉人力创造万民，
Eternal are Thy mercies, Lord;
Eternal truth attends Thy Word.

赐人粮食，赐人心身， 
招收万众进祂羊羣。
Thy praise shall sound from shore to shore,
Till suns rise and set no more.

大家踊跃来到主前， 
欢欣快乐进主院庭，
Your lofty themes, Ye mortals, bring,
In songs of praise divinely sing;

同心合意，感谢真神， 
高声颂扬赞美主名。
The great salvation loud proclaim,
And shout for joy the Savior’s Name.

天涯地角，皆当歌颂， 
直到红日不复升沉。
In cheerful sounds all voices raise,
And fill the world with loudest praise.

恳求圣父临格，
助我赞美主名 敬献心声！
Come, Thou almighty King, 
Help us Thy name to sing, 
Help us to praise!

惟主无上尊荣，惟主完全得胜
求主统治我们，万古之神！
Father all glorious O'er all 
victorious, Come, and reign over 
us, Ancient of Days!

恳求圣子临格， 
彰显威严大能，垂听呼声！

 Come, Thou incarnate Word, 
Gird on Thy mighty sword, 
Our prayer attend;

施恩与众子民，使主圣道振兴
建立正义公平，救主良朋！

Come, and Thy people bless,
And give Thy Word success; Spirit of holiness On us descend!

恳求圣灵临格，
显出神圣见证 感化众人

Come, holy Comforter, 
Thy sacred witness bear,
In this glad hour:

惟主全能至尊，恳求统治众心
永不离开我们，大能圣灵！
Thou who almighty art, Now rule in every heart, And ne'er from us depart, Spirit of power!

slides.content:
因祂洪恩常护佑， 
信实不变永昭彰。

For His mercies still endure
Ever faithful, ever sure.

黑夜更使皓月照， 
光华四射映碧空。
For His mercies still endure
Ever faithful, ever sure.

讚主更賜降天糧，

For His mercies still endure. Ever faithful, ever sure.

slides.content:
虽为宇宙至大中心， 
仍与爱主之民相亲， 
仍与爱主之民相亲。
Center and soul of every sphere 
Yet to each loving heart how near!
 Yet to each loving heart how near!

希望之星，哲哲其柔，
漫漫长夜，慰我心灵， 
漫漫长夜，慰我心灵。
Star of our hope, Thy softened light 
Cheers the long watches of the night, Cheers the long watches of the night.

恩典之兆，在天为虹; 
罪翳之外，无非主荣， 
罪翳之外，无非主荣。
Our rainbow arch, Thy mercy's sign; All, save the clouds of sin, are Thine, All, save the clouds of sin, are Thine.

主施真理，我获释放，
我心善念，为主激扬，

for Thee;

圣光煜煜，圣焰煌煌。
Till all Thy living altars claim
One holy light, one heavenly flame!
One holy light, one heavenly flame.

朝见天父面，藉赖耶稣名;     
跪在父脚前，忏悔己罪行。
  向父重呼吁，哀声远天庭;     
求父赐怜憫，听我歌颂声。
Father, again in Jesus' Name we meet,
And bow in penitence beneath Thy feet:
Again to Thee our feeble voices raise,
To sue for mercy, and to sing Thy praise.

父眷何其隆，父爱何其博;                  
独惭自疏忽，离主任飘泊。  
闻父召唤声，鼓舞宜醒觉;     
罪人归去来，父家原足乐。

Alas, unworthy of Thy boundless love,
Too oft with careless feet from Thee we rove;But now, encouraged by Thy voice, 
we come,  Returning sinners to a Father's       home.

大哉主圣名，丰盛盈居处;                  
仁爱何深厚，举世叹弗如。  
舍身流宝血，竟为罪人死;   
  求开恩典门，天城容我住。

O by that Name in whom all fullness dwells
O by that love which every love excels,
O by that blood so freely shed for sin,
Open blest mercy's gate, and take us in.

遵从宝训离弃世俗，
专心爱主，永不变迁。

By Thy teachings sweet and holy,
Drawn from earth to love Thee solely.

我在迷途本无知，
悟性全被黑暗遮蔽; 
 

All our knowledge, sense, and sight
Lie in deepest darkness shrouded.
2

幸蒙圣灵赐帮助，
将主真光照我心地。


Till Thy Spirit breaks our night
With the beams of truth unclouded.
2

惟主能使我等归依，
求主运行，使我成义。


Thou alone to God canst win us;
Thou must work all good within us.         2

至圣之主极尊荣，
众光之源，从父而生;  

Glorious Lord, Thy self impart!
Light of light, from God proceeding.
3

但愿主灵常感召，
开我心窍，赐我聪明;  

Open Thou our ears and heart
Help us, by Thy Spirit’s pleading.
  3

恳主垂顾听我吁求，
悦纳颂赞，赐福无垠。

Hear the cry Thy people raises!
Hear, and bless our prayer and praises!     
3

title_en: Lord, We Come Before Thee Now

slides.content:
灵性生命全依凭，恳施怜憫惠然临;     
心满慈恩何丰盈，口唱新歌颂主名， 
口唱新歌颂主名。
 
In Thine own appointed way,
Now we seek Thee; here we stay.
Lord, from hence we would not go,
Till a blessing Thou bestow. 
2

求藉圣言传嘉音，赏赐安乐保康宁;  
但愿圣灵赐救恩，充满每颗虔诚心， 
充满每颗虔诚心。

Send some message from Thy word
That may joy and peace afford.
Comfort those who weep and mourn;
Let the time of love return.
3

求慰悲泣哀伤人，欢乐时光得重温;  
更求举拔沮丧者，加强希望增信心， 
加强希望增信心。
Comfort those who weep and mourn,
Let the time of joy return; 
Those that are cast down lift up,
Make them strong in faith and hope,
Make them strong in faith and hope.  4

惟愿万众均认明，主乃慈悲至尊神;  
医治病者释罪奴，同在主内乐无垠， 
同在主内乐无垠。

Grant we all may seek and find
Thee, our gracious God, and kind.
Heal the sick; the captive free.
         Let us all rejoice in Thee.       5

title_en: Lord, Open Thou My Heart to Hear

slides.content:
24 開我心門  Lord, Open Thou My Heart to Hear ()
求主为我大开心门， 
得明圣道去假归真，
Lord, open Thou my heart to hear,
And through Your Word to me draw near;

持守真理不受迷惑， 
作主儿女常与主亲。
Let me Your Word e'er pure retain;
Let me Your child and heir remain.

主道光大感动我心， 
主道医我身体心灵，
Thy Word doth deeply move the heart,
Thy Word doth perfect health impart,
2

主道令我喜乐满足， 
赐我安慰并予永生。
Thy Word my soul with joy doth bless,
Thy Word brings peace and happiness.
2

荣耀圣父，圣子，圣灵， 
无始无终，同权同能; 
 
To God the Father, God the Son,
And God the Spirit, Three in One.
3

称颂赞美三位一体， 
自今以后永远不停。

Shall glory, praise, and honor be
Now and throughout eternity.      
3

25 巍巍聖堂  How Pleasant, How Divinely Fair ()
巍巍圣堂，美丽庄严， 
万军之父，灵驻其间; 
 
How pleasant, how divinely fair,
O Lord of hosts, Thy dwellings are!

顾我罪心，既污且贱， 
今朝欢庆，得见圣颜。

With long desire my spirit faints
To meet th’assemblies of Thy saints.

灵光普照，我心融怡， 
引吭颂赞，造化神奇。

There they behold Thy gentle rays,
And seek Thy face, and learn 
                   Thy praise.

徘徊歧路，无处问津， 
赖主引进锡安之门;  

Blest are the men whose hearts are set. 
To find the way to Zion’s gate.
3

感神敷佑，一路施恩， 
从兹脱俗，作主圣民。

God is their strength; and through the road. They lean upon their helper, God.

刚强壮胆，努力奋兴， 
与众圣徒共趋天庭;   

Cheerful they walk, with growing strength, Till all shall meet in heaven at length. 
    4

直至将来新城相会， 
俯伏崇拜三一真神。

Till all before Thy face appear, 
And join in nobler worship there.

title_en: Lord, Dismiss Us With Thy Blessing

slides.content:
振我精神，
振我精神，
行过旷野远路程。
O refresh us, O refresh us, 
Traveling through this wilderness.

我愿尽忠，
我愿尽忠，
一生跟从主脚踪。
Ever faithful, Ever faithful 
To the truth may we be found.

title_en: Savior, Again to Thy Dear Name

slides.content:
直至闻慈声： “战事今已完”
召我到主旁，永享主平安。

then, when Thy voice shall bid our conflict cease, call us, 
O Lord, to Thine eternal peace.  
3

28  願主賜福保守 God Bless and Keep Thee ()
愿主赐福保守你一生， 
求主眷顾引领你路程，
God bless and keep Thee through all Thy days,
God bless and keep Thee in all Thy ways;

“米斯巴” 诉离情， 毋忘永保忠贞， 直至祂日重聚，
同颂主名。

“Mizpah” our parting sweet, “Mizpah” our heart repeat, Till we again shall 
meet with songs of praise.

隆情厚意永在，憩息共享主爱， 
世念俗虑消除，欢然相会。

How good to be where God’s children meet,
How good to worship at Jesus’ feet;
2

我等所有需要， 耶稣无不供应; 
但愿早日重聚，赞主深恩。

Jesus our need supplies, 
And who on Him relies He ever 
      satisfies;  His praise resound.  
3

专诚感谢呼吁求恩， 
举目仰望天城。

To Thee will I direct my prayer,
To Thee lift up mine eye

圣灵引我一生脚步， 
常在仁义道路;   

Up to the hills where Christ is gone
To plead for all His saints,
2

为我修直当往之途， 
免致失足错误。

Presenting at His Father's Throne
Our songs and our complaints.      
2

罪人必然永远灭亡， 
离开救主荣光。

Make every path of duty straight
  And plain before my face.           
3

上主遣使四围保护， 
平康安乐无穷。

The mighty God will compass them
With favor as a shield.               
4

护我安眠，经过黑夜
洁我思想，使我新生
Through sleep and darkness safely brought,
Restored to life and power and 
thought.

倘我每天所做事情， 
能在主中全成为圣，
 If, on our daily course, our mind
Be set to hallow all we find,
2

主将赐我无价之珍， 
使我更能向主献呈。
New treasures still, of countless price,
God will provide for sacrifice. 
2

敬求主爱眷顾我身， 
使我配享完全安宁;     
Only, O Lord, in Thy dear love,
Fit us for perfect rest above,
3

敬求日日导我助我， 
使我能依祈祷而行。
And help us, this and every day,
To live more nearly as we pray. 
3

31  AH 43 頌揚基督  When Morning Gilds the Skies  ()
朝曦灿烂如金，
我心初醒歌颂， 
颂扬基督耶稣！
 
When morning gilds the skies my heart awaking cries,
May Jesus Christ be praised!

无论祈祷做工， 
一样与主交通，
颂扬基督耶稣！

Alike at work and prayer, to Jesus I repair:
May Jesus Christ be praised!

倘若愁满心头，
安慰何处寻求？  
颂扬基督耶稣！
The night becomes as day when from the heart we say:
May Jesus Christ be praised!
2

人间幸福几何？  
安慰还是此歌，
颂扬基督耶稣！

The powers of darkness fear when this sweet chant they hear:
May Jesus Christ be praised!

但愿一息尚存，
不负此歌神圣， 
颂扬基督耶稣！
Be this, while life is mine, my canticle divine:
May Jesus Christ be praised!
 3

但愿此歌悠久;  
唱到万古千秋，
颂扬基督耶稣！

Be this th'eternal song through all the 
ages long,
May Jesus Christ be praised!

32 我靈速醒 Awake My Soul ()
我灵速醒,与日兢争,
竭力尽你一天责任 
Awake, my soul, and with the sun
thy daily stage of duty run;

驱除惰性, 欢然奋兴,
清晨向主, 敬献虔诚
shake off dull sloth, and joyful rise 
to pay thy morning sacrifice.

竭力增进技能德行， 
准备末日见主圣颜。

guard my first springs of thought and will,
and with thyself my spirit fill. 
2

求主今日引导治理， 
无论思想，行为，言语，
 
Direct, control, suggest, this day,
all I design or do or say;
 3

使我振起全副精神， 
与主荣耀结成一体。
that all my powers, with all their might,
in Thy sole glory may unite.      
3

title_en: The Sun Is On the Land and  Sea

slides.content:
但願榮耀歸與聖父,聖子基督, 
以及聖靈,三位一體,常施洪福; 
榮耀全歸三一真神,永生之主!
All glory to the Father be,
With Christ the Son,
And, Holy Spirit, unto Thee,
Forever One;
All glory to the Trinity
   While ages run!                   4

昨晚天父施恩保护， 
一夜平安舒泰;  
早起我要祈祷敬拜， 
感谢天父大爱。

恳求救主今日保护， 
使我所作纯正;  
恳赦我罪过免受灾祸，
   引导照顾安稳。                  2

慈悲圣灵住我心中， 
助我显明仁爱;  
赐我力量行走正路， 
  免受试探伤害。                    3

title_en: Forth In Thy Name, O Lord

slides.content:
35 遵命作工 Forth In Thy Name, O Lord ()
仰赖主名奋力前行， 继续奔走每日途程;  所有思想，言语，
行为， 决意完全遵从主命。

Forth in thy name, O Lord, I go, 
my daily labor to pursue; Thee, 
only Thee, resolved to know in all I think or speak or do.

求主为我指定事工， 使我欢欣乐意完成;   一切工作有主亲临， 显明善良完美之心。
The task thy wisdom hath assigned, O let me cheerfully fulfill; in all my works Thy presence find, and prove Thy good and perfect will.            2

使我负主容易之轭， 儆醒祈祷，
无时或息， 专心仰望永恒天国， 
迅速奔迎光荣大日。

Thee may I set at my right hand, 
whose eyes mine in-most substance see, 
and labor on at thy command, 
and offer all my works to Thee.
                                                           3

深愿借主所赐洪恩， 随时奉行任何圣命， 一路奔跑，始终欢欣， 
紧随救主，同上天庭。

For Thee delightfully employ what e'er Thy bounteous grace hath given; and run my course with even joy, and closely walk with Thee to heaven           4

title_en: Softly Now the Light of Day

slides.content:
36 AH48 暮色蒼茫  Softly Now the Light of Day  ()
白昼光阴渐过去， 一天暮色渐苍茫;  
离却世间劳与苦，我愿就主献心香。

Softly now the light of day
Fades upon out sight away:
Free from care, from labor free,
Lord, we would commune with Thee.

内心外表诸般罪， 都在圣明洞鉴中， 
求主可怜我软弱， 一齐消灭永无踪。

Thou, whose all pervading eye
nought escapes, without, within,
Pardon each infirmity,
       Open fault, and secret sin. 
2

我生有涯转眼过，白昼光明去不回;  
恳求消除尤与罪，召我永与主相偕。

Soon from us the light of day
Shall forever pass away;
Then, from sin and sorrow free,
Take us, Lord, to dwell with Thee. 
3

37  SDA#49黃昏求恩  Savior Breathe an Evening Blessing ()
主阿白昼光阴度完,夕阳下暮色苍茫 
祈求赦免我诸罪孽, 我愿救主献心香

Savior, breathe an evening blessing,
Ere repose our spirits seal;
Sin and want we come confessing;
Thou canst save, and Thou canst heal.

夜景黑暗令人惊恐, 都在圣明洞鉴中 
上主大能永不衰竭, 主民蒙恩福无穷

Though the night be dark and dreary,
Darkness cannot hide from Thee;
Thou art He who, never weary,
Watchest where Thy people be.  
2

虽有灾害苦难可惊, 仇敌毒箭纷纷临  
惟众圣使周围看护, 酣然入睡安身心

Though destruction walk around us,
Though the arrow past us fly,
Angel guards from Thee surround us,
We are safe if Thou art nigh.        
3

若果今夜长眠主怀, 安息等候主再来  
光明之晨主唤醒我, 高歌颂扬主大爱

Should swift death this night o’ertake us,
And our couch become our tomb,
May the morn of glory wake us,
Clad in light and deathless bloom.        
4

求助无门，安慰也无求处， 
常助孤苦之神，与我同居。

When other helpers fail 
and comforts flee,
Help of the helpless, O abide with me.

变化无常，环境何能留住？ 
 恳求不变之神，与我同居。

Change and decay in all around I see;
O Thou who changest not, 
abide with me.  
 2

我深需主，时刻需主护庇， 
惟赖主恩，能将试诱抗拒;  
I need Thy presence every passing hour.
What but Thy grace can foil the tempter's power? 
3

谁能如主，时常导引扶持？  
无论风雨晦明，恳求同居。

Who, like Thyself, my guide and stay can be? Through cloud and sunshine, Lord, abide with me.                           
3

坟墓威权，锋芒今在何处？  
我仍欣然得胜，主若同居。

Where is death's sting? Where, grave, thy victory? I triumph still, if Thou abide with me!
 4

title_en: Day Is Dying in the West

slides.content:

肃立敬拜主座前仰见羣星布夜天， 
灿烂无边。 
Day is dying in the west; Heaven is touching earth with rest; Wait and worship while the night. Sets the evening lamps alight through all the sky.

圣哉，圣哉，圣哉，万有真神！  
荣耀能力满诸天宇宙羣生同颂恩， 
至高至尊！

Holy, Holy, Holy, Lord God of Hosts!
Heaven and earth are full of Thee!
Heaven and earth are praising Thee,
O Lord most high!

生命主宰永垂恩救拔罪人作子民， 
求聚吾众入天庭欢欣瞻仰主圣容， 
长享安宁。
Lord of life, beneath the dome  of  the universe, Thy home, gather us who seek Thy face. To the fold of Thy embrace,       for Thou art nigh.                 2

圣哉，圣哉，圣哉，万有真神！  
 荣耀能力满诸天宇宙羣生同颂恩，
 至高至尊！

Holy, Holy, Holy, Lord God of Hosts!
Heaven and earth are full of Thee!
Heaven and earth are praising Thee,
O Lord most high!

大地沉沉黑影深鸿爱庇覆众生灵， 
吾众感恩同赞扬穿逾星月达天庭，
 献上心声。

While the deepening shadows fall, heart of love enfolding all. Through the glory and the grace of the stars that veil Thy face,
       Our hearts ascend. 3

圣哉，圣哉，圣哉，万有真神！ 
 荣耀能力满诸天宇宙羣生同颂恩， 至高至尊！

Holy, Holy, Holy, Lord God of Hosts!
Heaven and earth are full of Thee!
Heaven and earth are praising Thee,
O Lord most high!

将来昼夜与星月在主光中必隐没。   但愿黎明速来到晨曦不灭常照耀， 黑暗全消。

When forever from our sight pass the stars, the day, the night,
Lord of angels, on our eyes. Let eternal morning rise and shadows end.     4

圣哉，圣哉，圣哉，万有真神！  
荣耀能力满诸天宇宙羣生同颂恩， 
至高至尊！

Holy, Holy, Holy, Lord God of Hosts!
Heaven and earth are full of Thee!
Heaven and earth are praising Thee,
O Lord most high!

40 AH 52  白晝已過 Now The Day Is Over  ()
白昼刚才过去，黑夜正来临， 
悄然横断天际，几许黄昏影。

Now the day is over,
Night is drawing nigh,
Shadows of the evening
Steal across the sky.

恳求垂怜疲者，赐甜蜜安宁;  
有主温柔祝福，我好闭双睛。

Father, give the weary
Calm and sweet repose;
With Thy tenderest blessing
May our eyelids close.
2

经过漫漫长夜，愿天使展开， 
他们洁白羽翼，保护我安睡。

Through the long night watches,
May Thine angels spread
Their white wings above me,
Watching round my bed.
 3

41 AH53  晚間頌主   All Praise To Thee  ()
今夕向主感谢称扬，
因主日间，赐我明光; 
 
All praise to Thee, my God, this night,
for all the blessings of the light!

求用全能羽翼覆我， 
覆我护我，万王之王。

Keep me, O keep me, King of Kings,
beneath thine own almighty wings.

一日之中，罪恶重重， 
我赖圣子，求父宽容，

Forgive me, Lord, for thy dear Son,
the ill that I this day have done,

2

未睡之前，求主使我， 
与主亲近，与人和融。

that with the world, myself, and Thee,
I, ere I sleep, at peace may be.
2

求使我灵靠主安宁， 
恬然睡卧，直到明晨，
 
O may my soul on Thee repose,
and with sweet sleep mine eyelids close,
3

一夜休息，醒来有力， 
为主作工，愈加奋兴。

sleep that may me more vigorous 
Make to serve my God when I awake.
3

赞美圣灵，保惠之师， 
大哉！ 大哉！ 三一真神。

praise Him above, Ye heavenly host;
praise Father, Son, and Holy Ghost.
4

使我们早起，向主献晨歌， 
今将安息，再奏颂声。

to Thee our morning hymns ascended;
Thy praise shall hallow now our rest.

我们向主，奉献至敬心， 
静看大地由暗入明， 

We thank Thee that Thy church, unsleeping while earth rolls onward      into light,  
             2

普天之下，教会常儆醒， 
不分昼夜，服事人羣。

through all the world her watch is keeping, and rests not now by day 
      or night.     2

太阳刚才已辞别我们， 
又去唤醒西方弟兄， 


As o'er each continent and island
the dawn leads on another day,
3

时时刻刻，到处新歌颂， 
轮流赞美奇妙神功。


the voice of prayer is never silent,
nor die the strains of praise away.
3

家国兴衰，转瞬成陈迹， 
只有主座永远长存， 

So be it, Lord; Thy throne shall never,
like earth's proud empires, pass away.
4

发荣滋长， 永恒之盛绩， 
直到众生向主输诚。

Thy kingdom stands, and grows forever,
till all Thy creatures own Thy sway.               4

43   神爱深奥莫测  Eternal Depth of Love Divine   ()
神爱伟大，深奥莫测， 
以马内利真神下降， 
上主荣光何等辉煌！  

Eternal depth of love divine,
In Jesus, God with us, displayed;
How bright Thy beaming glories shine!

医治仁泽广被万方
医治仁泽广被万方  


How wide Thy healing streams are spread!
How wide Thy healing streams are spread!

上主乐愿与谁同居？  
忘恩负义污秽罪众， 
口舌焉能述主慈哀， 

With whom dost Thou delight to dwell?
Sinners, a vile and thankless race:
O God, what tongue aright can tell
2

神爱无边神恩无穷
神爱无边神恩无穷


How vast thy love, how great Thy grace!
How vast thy love, how great Thy grace!
  
2

大君所颁圣旨明令， 
吾等均愿乐意奉行;  
力有不逮求主玉成， 

The dictates of Thy sovereign will
With joy our grateful hearts receive:
All Thy delight in us fulfill;
3

谨献所有永不变更
谨献所有永不变更

Lo! all we are to Thee we give.  
3

主爱确实，主眷真诚，

title_en: There Is A Green Hill Far Away

slides.content:
离此遥远有一座城， 
城外有座青山， 

There is a green hill far away, 
Without a city wall,

在那山上，主被钉死,
替人受苦受难。

Where the dear Lord was crucified, Who died to save us all.

主受痛苦,何等艰辛,
实在无法说明;
  

We may not know, we cannot tell, 
What pains He had to bear,

我只相信救主受害，
是为我众罪人。


But we believe it was for us, 
He hung and suffered there.

救主流血,使我成圣, 
使我得免罪愆， 


He died that we might be forgiven, 
He died to make us good,

使我最后得升天庭，
不再被罪牵连。


That we might go at last to heaven, Saved by His precious blood.

世间没有这样完人， 
能付罪恶代价， 

There was no other good enough
 To pay the price of sin;

只有耶稣能开天门， 
呼召我众回家。

He only could unlock the gate 
Of heaven, and let us in.

温柔救主向前进行， 
棕枝衣服，满路铺陈。

O Savior meek, pursue Thy road
With palms and scattered garments strew.

巍然乘驴向前进行！  
卑微模样，是去成仁;  

Ride on! Ride on in majesty!
In lowly pomp ride on to die,

O’er captive death and conquered sin.

Waiting and watching,

title_en: O What Their Joy Must Be

slides.content:
勇士加冠冕， 倦旅得休憩， 
上主为王，统治万有无极。

Crown for the valiant, to weary ones rest; God shall be all, and in all ever blest.

耶路撒冷乃彼岸之美名 
平安之远景，带来真欢欣;

Truly Jerusalem name we that shore; Vision of peace that brings joy for evermore 
2

愿望必达成，永不再离分， 
凡有所求，都必蒙主垂听

Wish and fulfillment are not severed
   be ne’er, Nor the thing prayed for          come short of the prayer.

在那地方无烦恼无忧伤， 
锡安之诗歌， 欢然同声唱;

There, where no troubles distraction can bring, 
  we the sweet anthems of Zion shall     sing;          3

因主大恩典， 深广无可量， 
有福之民，永远齐心颂扬。

While for thy grace, Lord, 
   their voices of praise Thy blessed    people eternally raise.

我等心中都向往那天乡， 
彼处何荣美， 眼目常仰望; 

Now, in the meanwhile, with hearts raised on high, we for that country must yearn and must sigh;           
4

飘流在异邦受尽欺凌苦， 
惟盼圣城早日降得安康。

Seeking Jerusalem, dear native land, through our long exile on Babylon's strand.

我等恭敬同伏拜颂扬主， 
我等全属主， 靠主得福祉;

Low before Him with our praises we  fall, of whom, and in whom, and      through whom are all.   
5

荣耀归圣父， 圣子与圣灵， 
三一真神，大哉永恒统治。

Of whom, the Father; and in whom, 
the Son, through whom, the Spirit, with These ever One.

困倦心灵得享安息
随风飘来花香。  

Over the heart of the weary,
Breathing thy waves of balm.

伊甸乐园美丽家乡,
升平福乐家乡;  

Beautiful valley of Eden,
Home of the pure and blest,

每当狂风暴浪侵袭下,
我便渴望那家乡。

How often amid the wild billows
I dream of thy rest, sweet rest!

忧愁叹息尽都消亡
白昼光耀辉煌;  

Over the heart of the mourner
Shineth thy golden day,
2

千万天军同声歌唱
颂赞遍传八荒。  

Wafting the songs of the angels
Down from the far away.  
2

伊甸乐园美丽家乡

How often amid the wild billows
 I dream of thy rest, sweet rest!

光明荣耀遍及各方

Over the highlands of glory

131 義者家鄉 I Will Sing You A Song  ()
我要唱一篇诗，称赞那美地方， 
得救的义人在此住; 

I will sing you a song of that beautiful land,
The far away home of the soul,

在那处无风暴侵袭此光明邦
永远住在那太平地， 

Where no storms ever beat on the glittering strand, While the years of eternity roll,

永远住在那太平地; 
在那处无风暴侵袭此光明邦， 
永远住在那太平地。
While the years of eternity roll; Where no storms ever beat on the glittering strand, While the years of eternity roll.

及至到我想见此义者之家乡
我心满欢喜深向往，

Till I fancy but thinly the veil 
intervenes between the fair city 
and me,

彼为万王之王掌大权至无极
我等冠冕在祂手里，

The King of all kingdoms forever 
is He, 
And He holdeth our crowns in 
      His hands,

我等冠冕在祂手里; 
彼为万王之王掌大权至无极， 
我等冠冕在祂手里。
And He holdeth our crowns in His hands; The King of all kingdoms 
forever is He, And 
He holdeth our crowns in His hands.

我在此安乐乡极快慰极欢欣， 
永远无苦楚无忧伤;  

Oh, how sweet it will be in that 
beautiful land,
 So free from all sorrow and pain,

众圣徒在彼处手常执那金琴
合口赞美主齐声唱， 

With songs on our lips and our 
harps in our hands, To meet one another again,

soon our happy hearts will quiver

title_en: Soon May the Last Glad Song Arise

slides.content:
133  歡樂歌聲上騰 Soon May the Last Glad Song Arise
惟愿欢乐歌声上腾
穿越诸天传遍穹苍; 

Soon may the last glad song arise
Through all the millions of the skies,

凯旋诗歌向众宣明： 
全地今属万王之王。

That song of triumph which records
That all the earth is now the Lord’s.

陆地平原江河海洋， 
归主治理永庆安康。

And over land and stream and main
Wave Thou the scepter of Thy reign.

惟愿乐歌立时上腾， 
全地传布得胜佳音; 

O let that glorious anthem swell,
Let host to host the triumph tell,
3

背逆生灵无一留存， 
救主作王永治万民。

Till not one rebel heart remains,
       But over all the Savior reigns!

134 聖靈歌  May the Holy Spirit’s Sword （）
但愿圣灵刀斧，刺透我心深处， 
教我服耶稣，抛去刀枪旗鼓， 
安抚，安抚，使我归降恩主。

134 聖靈歌  May the Holy Spirit’s Sword  （）

体恤我忧劳，除尽我心烦恼，

134 聖靈歌  May the Holy Spirit’s Sword  （）
但愿圣灵同在，好像太阳光彩，

title_en: O for That Flame of Living Fire

slides.content:
135 AH264 懇賜聖靈活火O for That Flame of Living Fire ()
恳主赐下圣灵活火， 
犹如昔日照耀圣民;  

O for that flame of living fire
Which shone so bright in saints 
of old:

促其奋力奔行天路， 
遇危泰然遇难镇静！

Which bade their souls to heaven aspire
Calm in distress in danger bold!

亚伯拉罕所怀精神， 
如今世上何处可寻？  
Where is that spirit, Lord which
 dwelt in Abraham’s breast, and  sealed him Thine?      
2

当如保罗哀恸悔改， 
而后为主大发热心。
Which made Paul’s heart with 
sorrow melt,
      And glow with energy divine?

历世历代同一精神， 
宣扬主爱，使道彰明， 
That spirit which from age to age
Proclaim Thy love, and taught 
Thy ways?       
3

使以赛亚篇章放光， 
更使大卫诗歌丰盈。
Brightened Isaiah’s vivid page,
And breathed in David’s hallowed lays?

上主恩典是否失效？  
以利亚时何等奇妙！
  
Is not Thy grace as mighty now
As when Elijah felt its power?
4

又使摩西脸面发光， 
约伯能忍试炼讥诮。

When glory beamed from Moses’ brow,
Or Job endured the trying hour?

此刻吾众同心求主， 
惟愿圣灵沛然下降。

And while to Thee our hearts we raise,
On us Thy Holy Spirit pour.

我在旷野难行走
仰望圣灵常导引;
  
Gently lead us by the hand, 
pilgrims in a desert land.

困乏之人心欢欣
因听圣灵微小声： 

Weary souls fore’er rejoice, while they hear that sweetest voice,

迷路罪人跟我来
我必领你上天庭。

Whispering softly, “Wanderer, 
come, follow Me, I’ll guide thee home.”

主既愿作我良友
求主亲近常保佑;
  
Ever present, truest Friend, 
ever near Thine aid to lend,
2

切莫撇我在幽暗
还求替我卸重担;  

Leave us not to doubt and fear, groping on in darkness drear.
2

或有灾难忽然临
使我仍听祢声音：
 
When the storms are raging sore, hearts grow faint and hopes give     o’er.

迷路罪人跟我来
我必领你上天庭。

Whispering softly, “Wanderer,                come, follow Me, I’ll guide thee 
       home.”

劳苦世途将行毕
专望回家享安息;  

When our days of toil cease, 
waiting still for sweet release,
3

但求名录生命册
那时便能听祢声： 

Wading deep the dismal flood, pleading naught but Jesus’ blood,

迷路罪人跟我来
我必领你上天庭。

Whispering softly, “Wanderer, 
come, follow Me, I’ll guide thee       home.”
137 AH 260 聖靈充满  Hover O'er Me Holy Spirit   ()

作我教师，作我向导， 
指点我众心思言行。

Be Thou our Guardian, Thou our Guide, O’er every thought and 
step preside,

求使各人心怀敬畏， 
永远不离我主灵恩。

Plant holy fear in every heart,
That we from God may ne’er 
depart,

领我行主生命之途， 
禁我毋违救主法度;  

Lead us to Christ, the living way,
Nor let us from His pastures stray,
3

引我前行，披戴圣洁， 
来归上主必经此路。

Lead us to holiness the road
That we must take to dwell with God;

引我前行登天路程， 
至终分享无量欢欣;  

Lead us to Heav’n, its bliss to 
share,
Fullness of joy forever there, 
4

引我达到最后安息， 
与主同住万古永恒。

Lead us to our eternal rest,
To be with God forever bless’d

title_en: Breathe On Me, Breath Of God

slides.content:
139 AH 265 聖靈灌輸  Breathe On Me, Breath Of God  ()
恳求圣灵灌输， 
使我彻底重生， 

Breathe on me, breath of God, 
      Fill me with life anew,

使我能爱上主所爱， 
能行主所愿行。

That I may love what Thou dost love,
   And do what Thou wouldst do.

恳求圣灵灌输， 
直至我心洁净， 

Breathe on me, breath of God, 
Until my heart is pure,  
2

使我意愿与主合一， 
殷勤且耐艰辛。

Until with Thee I will one will, 
To do and to endure.

恳求圣灵灌输， 
直至浑然忘我，
 
Breathe on me, breath of God, 
Till I am wholly Thine,
3

使我肉身发起热情，
 心中燃起圣火。

Until this earthly part of me Glows with Thy fire divine.

恳求圣灵灌输， 
使我始终忠顺， 

Breathe on me, breath of God, 
So shall I constant be, 
4

使我最后与主同享 
永恒完全生命。

 And live with Thee the perfect    life of Thine eternity.

140  AH268 聖靈神光 Holy Spirit Light Divine
圣灵圣爱大光明， 
求赐神光照我心;  

Holy Spirit, light divine, 
Shine upon this heart of mine,

将我心中长黑夜， 
化为灿烂之清晨。

Chase the shades of night away, 
     Turn my darkness into day.

圣灵圣力大权能， 
求显神工洗我心;  

Holy Spirit, power divine, 
 Cleanse this guilty heart of mine;        2

久在罪中无管束， 
求主统治我心灵。

Long has sin, without control,
     Held dominion o‘er my soul.

圣灵圣乐大欢欣， 
求降纶音慰我心; 
 
Holy Ghost, with joy divine, 
Cheer this saddened heart of   mine       
3

破碎心怀多隐痛， 
从兹消灭不留痕。

Bid my many woes depart,  
Heal my wounded, bleeding heart.

圣灵圣德大无京， 
求屈尊严居我心;  

Holy Spirit, all divine, 
Dwell within this heart of mine, 
4

偶像万般皆除尽， 
统治我心永独尊。

Cast down every idol throne,
 Reign supreme, and reign        alone.

恳求将主仁爱火焰，
 热我冷淡之心。

Kindle a flame of sacred love
In these cold hearts of ours.

哀怜我们，风尘劳碌， 
留恋虚浮世俗;  

O raise our thoughts from things below,
From vanities and toys!
2

我灵努力勤求上进， 
望得永恒喜乐。

Then shall we with fresh courage go
  To reach eternal joys.  
2

广将救主恢宏之爱， 
燃起我等爱心。

Come, shed abroad a Savior's love,
 And that shall kindle ours.  
3

滋润我，滋润我，
恳赐余泽滋润我。

Even me, even me, 
Let some drops now fall on me.

怜恤我，怜恤我，
惟求赐恩怜恤我。

Even me, even me, 
 Let Thy mercy light on me.

大发亮光照我心里，
惟求圣灵引导我。  

Testify of Jesus' merit,
Speak the word of power to me;

引导我，引导我，
惟求圣灵引导我。

Even me, even me, 
Speak the word of power to me.

圣灵恩惠富足无限，
今求一齐赐给我。  

Grace of God, so strong and boundless
Magnify them all in me;

赐给我，赐给我，
今求一齐赐给我。

Even me, even me, 
   Magnify them all in me.

143 保惠師 Our Blest Redeemer
鸿恩救主离世之先， 
因使我众安全， 

Our blest Redeemer, ere He breathed
His tender last farewell,

曾遣圣灵，
保惠之师， 居我心间。

A Guide, a Comforter, bequeathed
   With us to dwell.

圣灵，慈悲和爱嘉宾， 
感化默助世人; 

He came sweet influence to impart,
a gracious, willing Guest,

谦卑之怀，
饥渴之心， 祂必降临。

while he can find one humble heart
   wherein to rest.

凡我嘉言，凡我善行， 
凡我战争得胜， 

And every virtue we possess,
and every conquest won,

善念，善性，圣业，
圣品， 赖主而成。

and every thought of holiness,
  are his alone.

宽容，温柔，清洁圣灵， 
求助软弱之心; 

Spirit of purity and grace,
our weakness, pitying, see:

洁此方寸，
堪为主殿， 与主更亲。

O make our hearts thy dwelling place
           and worthier Thee.

144 寶貴聖經   The Precious Bible
上帝命令众人宜听，
欢喜接受福音之声;  
圣经显示上帝大恩，
主救世界解人忧闷。

圣经自始至终真实，
滋味隽永甜逾蜂蜜;  
上帝道理无价之宝，
世上金银不能比较。

万民处在死亡荫影，
圣经显出上帝光荣;  
指示真理宣报福音，
圣神照亮我人之心。

圣经引领永生之路，
教人信从圣子耶稣;  
真光照我步履稳当，
坚固信望能到天上。

今我成为耶稣门徒，
常常研究上帝圣经;    
圣神感化各人之心，
能合天意喜乐满盈。

title_en: Break Thou the Bread of Life

slides.content:

求主赐我天上 永生之饼
如从前在海边分赐众人
Break thou the bread of life
Dear Lord, to me as thou didst break the loaves beside the sea

主阿,我在圣经切心找寻
赖主永生宝训养我性灵
Beyond the sacred page I seek thee, Lord my spirit pants for thee 
O Living Word
第145首 SDAH 271 ()

求主赐福圣书所显真理
如同从前分饼在加利利
Bless thou the truth, dear Lord 
To me, to me as thou didst bless the bread by Galilee
第145首 SDAH 271 ()

使我捆绑解除锁链脱身
凡事全赖我主永恒命令
Then shall all bondage cease 
All fetters fall
And I shall find my peace 
My all in all
第145首 SDAH 271 ()

第145首 SDAH 271 ()

I win the strife
第145首 SDAH 271 ()

听主圣言能胜万样竞争

146  AH 274 上帝聖言萬古存  O Word of God Incarnate    ()
上帝圣言万古存，智慧从天而降 
不易真理永辉煌，照彻幽暗八荒  

O Word of God incarnate, O Wisdom from on high, O Truth unchanged, unchanging, O Light of our dark sky:

神圣篇章发光芒，我等感戴颂扬 
常有明灯伴脚旁，永保福乐安康

we praise you for the radiance that from the hallowed page, a lantern to our footsteps, shines on from age to age.

教会从主受重托，谨领神圣妙道
高擎明光须普照，远及万千海岛  

The church from her dear Master received the gift divine, and still that light is lifted o‘er all the earth to 
  shine.  2

圣言犹如精金匣，珍藏真理至宝 
又如基督圣容图，上天描绘精巧

It is the sacred vessel where gems of truth are stored; it is the heaven-drawn picture of Christ, the living Word.

上帝圣言如旌旗，飘扬圣民之前  
长如灯塔放光明，照亮黑暗人间
  
It floateth like a banner before God's host unfurled; it is a shining beacon above the darkling world.
3

又如南针与海图，引渡苦海无边 
穿过云雾越暗礁，常与基督相联

It is the chart and compass that o'er life's surging tide, mid mists and 
rocks and quick sands, Still guides, 
O Christ, to Thee.

求主使此真教会，永如明灯长燃 
发光作证救生灵，热诚莫让先贤
  
O make Thy church, dear Savior, 
a lamp of purest gold, to bear before 
the nations, your true light as of old.
            4

更求指点迷路人，奔行天程不偏 
直至阴霾全消散，得见救主圣颜

O teach your wandering pilgrims by 
this their path to trace, till, 
clouds and darkness ended, 
they see Thee face to face.

赐我圣经 Give Me the Bible
求赐我圣经如晨星放光芒
使流浪之人 心中得欢畅
Give me the Bible star of gladness gleaming. To cheer the wanderer lone and tempest tossed

148 聖經至寶 Holy Bible, Book Divine
圣经原是上帝着实在是我宝藏库 
示我此身何自来示我生存何所为   

Holy Bible, Book divine,
Precious treasure, thou art mine;
Mine to tell me whence I came;
Mine to teach me what I am.

圣经时常能安慰因蒙圣灵赐恩惠 
指明有人靠主能必胜死亡得永生

Mine to comfort in distress;
Suffering in this wilderness;
Mine to show, by living faith,
     Man can triumph over death.  
3

指明顺者行坦途得进天乡享永福 
圣经原是上帝着实在是我宝藏库

Mine to tell of joys to come,
And the rebel sinner’s doom;
O thou holy Book divine,
 Precious treasure, thou art mine.            
4

149 腳前明燈  Lamp of Our Feet
圣经乃是脚前明灯有此不致迷道  
又如活水从天倾降供给旅客饮料

Lamp of our feet whereby we trace
Our path when want to stay;
Stream from the front for heavenly grace , Brook by the traveler’s way.

圣经乃是天上吗哪育养生命灵粮  
信徒读此便得南针明了天国方向  
Bread of our souls, whereon we feed,
True mama from on high;
Our guide and chart, wherein we read
Of realms beyond the sky 
2

圣经如同云柱火柱昼夜示我周行  
航海遇险又似巨锚能御波涛猖狂

Pillar of fire, through watches dark,
Or radiant cloud by day;
When waves would break our tossing bark, Our anchor and our stay
3

圣经乃是上帝圣言表彰圣子恩情  
 无此怎能行走世路怎能到达天庭
Word of the ever-lasting God
Will of His glorious Son;
Without Thee how could earth be trod,
Or heaven itself be won?
4

150 勞苦罪人請速來 Come, Ye Weary ()
劳苦罪人请速来何必负重徒呻吟 
耶稣邀召流浪子早日归向慈悲神  

Come ye weary sinners, come.
All who groan beneath your load,
Jesus calls His wanderers home,
Hasten to your pardoning God!

心灵压伤莫自误速即应答主呼声
来者我必赐安息施恩拯救免沉沦


God, ye guilty spirits oppressed,
Answer to the Savior’s call,
“Come, and I will give you rest;
Come, and I will save you all.”

仁爱耶稣即真理救主圣言我乐遵  
但求慈悲早彰显除我罪担洁我心
 
Jesus, full of truth and love,
We Thy kindest word obey;
Faithful let Thy mercies prove,
Take our load of guilt away;
       2

信赖恩主乐无极忧虑尽卸得康宁 
投靠慈怀永不移长享平安至永恒

Now we would on Thee rely, 
cast on Thee our every care, 
To Thine arms of mercy fly,
     Find our lasting quiet there.

世事俗虑压我心罪孽重担苦缠身 
疑云愁雾时侵扰上帝忿怒堪震惊
  
Burdened with a world of grief, burdened with our sinful load,
Burdened with this unbelief, 
burdened with the wrath of God;
3

今我就主求安舒敬恳慈悲信实神 
释我灵性诸重负赦我罪愆慰我心

Lo! We come to Thee for ease, 
true and gracious as Thou art,
Now our groaning souls release,  
  write forgiveness on our heart.

请听保惠恩师，温柔地说道： 
“世间的忧伤，上天能治疗”

Here speaks the Comforter, tenderly saying, "Earth has no sorrow that heaven cannot cure.”

参赴主备盛筵，心中常思想： 
 世间的忧伤，上天能抒散。

Come to the feast of love; come, ever knowing earth has no sorrow   but heaven can remove.

152  AH282我聽主聲歡迎 I Hear Thy Welcome Voice ()
我听主声欢迎
召我与主相亲

I hear Thy welcome voice
That calls me, Lord, to Thee,

在主所流宝血里面
我罪都能洗净

For cleansing in Thy precious blood
That flowed on Calvary.

主啊，我今来，
我今来就主; 
 
I am coming Lord!  
Coming now to Thee!

求用宝血洗净我
洗净一切罪污

Wash me, cleanse me in the blood That flowed on Calvary!

我虽软弱卑污
救主赐我能力

Though coming weak and vile,
Thou dost my strength assure;

将我污点完全洗净
丝毫不留痕迹  

Thou dost my vileness fully 
cleanse,
 Till spotless all, and pure.

主啊，我今来，
我今来就主;  

I am coming Lord!  
Coming now to Thee!

求用宝血洗净我
洗净一切罪污。

Wash me, cleanse me in the blood
 That flowed on Calvary!

耶稣招我向前
达到信爱完全

  ’Tis Jesus calls me on
To perfect faith and love,

完全指望平安信靠
在世犹如在天  

To perfect hope and peace and
 trust,
 For earth and heaven above.

主啊, 我今来，
我今来就主;  

I am coming Lord!  
Coming now to Thee!

求用宝血洗净我
洗净一切罪污。

Wash me, cleanse me in the blood
That flowed on Calvary!

美哉赎罪宝血
美哉救世宏恩

All hail! atoning blood!
All hail! redeeming grace!

美哉基督无边妙爱
赏赐公义权能  

All hail! the gift of Christ our Lord,
Our strength and righteousness.

主啊,我今来，
我今来就主;  

I am coming Lord!  
Coming now to Thee!

求用宝血洗净我
洗净一切罪污。

Wash me, cleanse me in the blood
      That flowed on Calvary!

title_en: I Heard the Voice of Jesus Say

slides.content:
你既困乏就当歇息
将头靠我胸膛 


Lay down, thou weary one, 
lay down Thy head upon My 
breast.”

我本劳苦疲倦忧愁
闻言即来就主


I came to Jesus as I was,
Weary and worn and sad;

在主怀中我心欢喜
觅得安身之处。


I found in Him a resting place,
And He has made me glad.

渴者都可自由取饮
便能出死入生。

thirsty one, stoop down and drink
 and live.”       
 2

我听主言即来就主
畅饮生命灵泉，
 
I came to Jesus, and I drank
Of that life giving stream;

我渴即止我心即甦
今活在主里面。

My thirst was quench’d, my soul        revived, And now I live in Him.

向我仰望;便见朝阳
终日照耀辉煌。 

look unto Me, Thy morn shall rise,       And all Thy day be bright.”  
3

我愿借此生命之光
奔行天国旅程。

And in that light of life I’ll walk, 
      Till trav’ling days are done.

155 可曾計算代價? Have You Counted The Cost ()
你若拒绝耶稣，藐视祂的慈爱 
甚至不顾圣灵的感化，

There’s a line there is drawn by rejecting our Lord, where the call of 
His Spirit is lost.

只管随流浮沉， 追求今生娱乐， 
可曾计算， 可曾计算代价？


And you hurry along with the 
pleasure mad throng. Have you 
counted, have you counted the cost?

可曾计算代价？ 若要赔上永生， 
虽能赚得全世界财富。

Have you counted the cost,
 if your soul should be lost
Tho’ you gain the whole world 
for your own.

劝你现在归主，接受祂的救恩， 
可曾计算，可曾计算代价？


Even now it may be that the line you have crossed, Have you counted, 
have you counted the cost?

你若赔上永生，撇弃一切希望， 
换来片刻虚空的快乐，

You may barter your hope of 
eternity’s morn,
For a moment of joy at the most,
2

为要满足私欲， 身心都不顾惜， 
可曾计算，可曾计算代价？

For glitter of sin and the things it will win 
Have you counted, have you counted the cost?                                                          2

可曾计算代价？ 若要赔上永生， 
虽能赚得全世界财富。

Have you counted the cost, 
if your soul should be lost
Tho’ you gain the whole world 
for your own.

劝你现在归主，接受祂的救恩， 
可曾计算，可曾计算代价？

Even now it may be that the line you have crossed, Have you counted, 
have you counted the cost?

趁着救恩的门，仍然向你开放， 
主还有无穷尽的慈爱，

While the door of His mercy is open 
to you,
Ere the depth of His love you exhaust,
3

你可愿来归主，答应祂的呼召？  
可曾计算，可曾计算代价？

Won’t you come and healed, 
won’t you whisper, I yield
I have counted, I have counted 
the cost.
         3

可曾计算代价？ 若要赔上永生， 
虽能赚得全世界财富。

Have you counted the cost, 
if your soul should be lost
Tho’ you gain the whole world 
for your own.

劝你现在归主，接受祂的救恩， 
可曾计算，可曾计算代价？


Even now it may be that the line you have crossed, Have you counted, 
have you counted the cost?

“圣灵暂请退回等待
   便利之时，我再求祢”

  “Go, Spirit, go Thy way,
  Some more convenient day
       on Thee I’ll call.”

几乎听劝今天就前来几乎听劝 
切不可离开，耶稣请你归回，
 

Almost persuaded, come, come today;
Almost persuaded; turn not away, 
Jesus invites you here,      
2

天使左右徘徊亲友
带你祈求，浪子回头。

Angels are lingering near, 
Prayers from hearts so dear;
 O wanderer, come!

几乎听劝收割快完结几乎
听劝，命运将永决！


Almost persuaded, harvest is past!
“Almost persuaded,” doom comes 
at last;  
3

几乎终属几乎,几乎仍等虚无， 
 错过得救良机，悔已晚矣！


“Almost” cannot avail; 
  “Almost” is but to fail!
  Sad, sad that bitter wail
          “Almost—but lost!”

157AH 283主在門外 O Jesus, Thou Art Standing  ()
主耶稣依然站立，被拒紧闭门外 
祂仍虚心仍忍耐，希望跨进门来
  
O Jesus, Thou art standing outside the fast closed door, in lowly patience waiting, to pass the threshold o'er:

我众忝作主门徒，忝负救主名号 
可羞，可羞真可羞让祂久立心焦

O shame, professing Christian,
His name and sign who bear,
O shame, thrice shame upon us,
To keep Him standing there!

主耶稣依然叩门，手中钉痕犹新 
头上依旧戴荆冠，慈容仍满泪痕  

O Jesus, Thou art knocking; and lo, 
that hand is scarred, and thorns Thy brow encircle, and tears Thy face 
   have marred. 2

人智难测此深爱，主竟耐心久待  
罪孽极重真可恨，常在门前阻碍

O Love that passeth knowledge,  
so patiently to wait!
O sin that has no equal, 
      So fast to bar the gate!

主耶稣依然低声殷勤苦劝开门  
我曾为你舍生命，你竟如此忍心  

O Jesus, Thou art pleading in accents meek and low,  "I died for you, 
My children, and will you treat Me so?”          3

听罢忧惭相交并，我便大开心门  
亲爱救主请进来，与我永远相亲

O Lord, with shame and sorrow
We open now the door;
Dear Savior, enter, enter,
     And leave us never more.

158  CH232  如鸟振翅  Flee As a Bird  ()
你为何不像小鸟般,
肃肃振翅高翔 ?
  
Flee as a bird to your mountain, 
       thou who art weary of sin;

离开那污浊的幽谷,
飞向生命的泉源？  
   
Go to the clear flowing fountain 
where you may wash and be clean.

主必让你睡在怀中
安慰你这罪路倦旅
安慰你这罪路倦旅
He on His bosom will bear thee; 
O thou who art weary of sin, 
O thou who art weary of sin.

主将要永远爱护你，
擦去你的泪痕！  
   
 He will protect thee forever, 
  wipe every falling tear;

祂是那安全避难所，
莫要愁无处可容  

He will protect thee forever, 
wipe every falling tear;

但愿你趁日晷未移
把握住这仅有时光; 

Haste, then, the hours are flying, 
spend not the moments in sighing,

将烦忧带向主面前
让祂替你擦去泪痕 
让祂替你擦去泪痕
Cease from your sorrow and crying: 
The Savior will wipe every tear, 
The Savior will wipe every tear.

159 CH 569 耶穌慈聲呼召Jesus Is Tenderly Calling()
耶稣慈声正在召你回家， 
今天呼召，今天呼召！ 

Jesus is tenderly calling you home
Calling today, calling today,

为何不接受祂最大慈爱， 
为何竟远远离开？

Why from the sunshine of love 
will you roam, farther and farther away?

今天呼召，今天呼召， 
耶稣慈声今日正向你发出呼召。

Calling today, calling today, 
Jesus is calling, is tenderly calling     today.

耶稣召疲倦人得享安息, 
今天呼召，今天呼召！

Jesus is calling the weary to rest,
Calling today, calling today,
2

重担卸给祂接受祂福气， 
祂总不把你丢弃。

Bring Him your burden and you 
shall be blest; 
He will not turn you away.

今天呼召，今天呼召， 
耶稣慈声今日正向你发出呼召。

Calling today, calling today,
Jesus is calling, is tenderly calling today.

耶穌正等候你趕快前來， 
今天等你， 今天等你！ 

Jesus is waiting, O come to Him 
now,
Waiting today, waiting today,
3

罪孽放祂腳下向祂跪拜， 
切莫遲疑莫懈怠！

Come with your sins, at His feet 
lowly bow; 
Come, and no longer delay.

今天呼召，今天呼召， 
耶稣慈声今日正向你发出呼召。

Calling today, calling today,
Jesus is calling, is tenderly calling today.

耶稣今恳求你听祂召请,
今天要听，今天要听！

Jesus is pleading, O list to His 
voice,
Hear Him today, hear Him today,
4

凡信主圣名必大得安宁， 
尽速起身去实行。

They who believe on His Name 
shall rejoice; 
Quickly arise and away.

今天呼召，今天呼召， 
耶稣慈声今日正向你发出呼召。

Calling today, calling today,
Jesus is calling, is tenderly calling today.

若仰望我主祂要助我力。

Oft as the clouds of temptation rise
A look at the cross still my strength shall be 
2

赐救恩，使我快乐;  
靠十架，必可得救。


Blessed thought, Salvation free
By a look at Calvary.

注目十字架时刻仰望主， 
凡祂所许必要成就;  

I’ll look at the cross e’vry day and 
hour
Trusting the promise God has given,
   3

魔鬼无权使圣民跌倒， 
因其遵主命并靠祂功劳。

None ever fall ‘neath the tempters pow’r
Who trust and obey in the strength of Heav’n  
   3

赐救恩，使我快乐;  
靠十架，必可得救。


Blessed thought, Salvation free
By a look at Calvary.

title_en: Come, Thou Fount of Every Blessing

slides.content:
上帝恩典如水长流，
我们高声颂恩惠。
  
streams of mercy, never ceasing, 
call for songs of loudest praise.

愿主教我唱诗和谐，
犹如天使唱主前; 
 
Teach me ever to adore Thee,
May I still Thy goodness prove,

上帝恩典实无穷尽，
主的慈爱无变迁。

While the hope of endless glory
Fill my heart with joy and love.

只求上帝永不离我，
才能免得遭沉沦。

and I hope, by Thy good pleasure,
safely to arrive at home.
2

并救我难为我舍命，
主流己血真至宝。

He, to rescue me from danger,
  interposed His precious blood. 
2

报主鸿恩我力不足，
万分之中难报一;  

O to grace how great a debtor
daily I'm constrained to be!
3

报主鸿恩我力不足，
万分之中难报一;
  
Let Thy goodness, like a fetter,
bind my wandering heart to Thee.
3

今将身心献为活祭，
恳求收纳莫丢弃。

here's my heart, O take and seal it,
  seal it for Thy courts above.  
3

title_en: One There is Above All Others

slides.content:
194 罪人良友 One There is Above All Others  ()
救主慈爱悠久宏深，
远胜其他一切人，
真可算得一位良朋，
超呼弟兄手足情;

世上朋友谁能谁愿，
为救我们甘受死？ 
惟有耶稣舍身成仁，
代我向父乞宽恕。

祂在世时被人轻看，
被人称为罪人友， 
今在天上，祂有光荣，
旧日称呼仍喜受;

可惜我们太易忘记，
天上有位好友人。 
求主化我铁石心肠，
教我终身爱主名。

195 AH 340 至寶佳音 Jesus Saves ()
我曾听至宝佳音：
主救人！ 主救人！  

We have heard a joyful sound, 
Jesus saves, Jesus saves;

到各处传此救恩：
主救人！ 主救人！  

Spread the gladness all around, 
Jesus saves, Jesus saves;

主命令嘱我前行，
普天下宣扬福音。  

Bear the news to every land, 
Climb the steeps and cross the waves,

作见证天涯海角，
主救人！ 主救人！

Onward 'tis our Lord's command, 
Jesus saves, Jesus saves.

如高潮传此佳音：
主救人！ 主救人！  

Waft it on the rolling tide, 
Jesus saves, Jesus saves;
2

要普告远近罪人：
主救人！ 主救人！  

Tell to sinners, far and wide, 
Jesus saves, Jesus saves;
2

各海岛欢乐歌唱，
诸岩洞齐声回应。  

Sing, ye islands of the sea, 
Echo back, ye ocean caves.

全地球乐守禧年，
主救人！ 主救人！

Earth shall keep her jubilee, 
   Jesus saves, Jesus saves.

争战时当高声唱：
主救人！ 主救人！  

Sing above the battle’s strife, 
Jesus saves, Jesus saves;
3

经幽谷轻声柔唱，
心中仰望主救恩;  

Sing it softly through the gloom,
When the heart for mercy craves,

过死河高声颂扬：
主救人！ 主救人！

Sing in triumph o’er the tomb, 
   Jesus saves, Jesus saves.

如狂风扬起歌声：
主救人！ 主救人！  

Give the winds a mighty voice, 
Jesus saves, Jesus saves;
4

传佳音薄海欢腾，
主救人！ 主救人！  

Let the nations now rejoice, 
Jesus saves, Jesus saves;
4

高声唱救主大恩，
宝血洗万国万民。  

Shout salvation full and free, 
Highest hills and deepest caves,

主救恩大大得胜，
主救人！ 主救人！

This our song of victory, 
 Jesus saves, Jesus saves.

196 福樂之地 There Is a Happy Land ()
有一福乐之地，路远难计， 
圣徒在荣耀里，明亮如日。
  
There is a happy land, far, far away,
Where saints in glory stand, bright, bright as day.

听他们齐颂扬，荣华归于救世王， 
赞美充满天上，永远歌唱。

Oh, how they sweetly sing, worthy is our Savior king, Loud let His praises ring, praise, praise for aye.

请到那福乐地，与主相会， 
为何未定主意，为何推诿。
  
Come to that happy land, come, come away;
Why will ye doubting stand, why still delay?
2

天国得福全备，脱离罪恶无忧累， 
永远与主相会，享福万岁。

Oh, we shall happy be, when from sin and sorrow free, Lord, we shall live  with Thee, blest, blest for aye.  
2

得住那福乐地，快慰难言， 
天父一时不离，信爱两全。  

Bright, in that happy land, beams every eye;
Kept by a Father’s hand, love cannot die.
3

快来领主恩典，必得赏赐戴金冕， 
比日光更明显，掌权无边。

Oh, then to glory run; be a crown and kingdom won; And, bright, above the sun, we reign for aye.                      
3

圣子永远与相偕，白昼光辉明朗;  
草场安置百花地，白云深处家乡。

The Prince is ever in them, 
The daylight is serene; The pastures 
of the blessed are deck in glorious  sheen.

彼众昔曾在尘世，从主克敌沙场， 
如今身穿圣洁袍，遍体雪白辉煌。

And they who, with their Leader, Have conquered in the fight,
Forever and forever Are clad in robes of white.

美丽多福之天邦，上主选民家乡！  
美丽多福之天邦，万众同心仰望。  

O sweet and blessed country,
The home of God's elect! O sweet and blessed country, That eager hearts expect!

title_en: Glorious Things of Thee Are Spoken

slides.content:
谁能摇动你的根基？ 
万古磐石诚坚固。  

On the Rock of Ages founded, 
what can shake thy sure repose?

救恩墙垣，周围环绕，
谈笑对敌无惊怖。

With salvation's walls surrounded, Thou mayst smile at all thy foes.

生命活水，源远流长，
从主爱中常涌出;  

See, the streams of living waters, springing from eternal love, 
 well supply thy sons and daughters,  
2

上帝儿女，都蒙供给，
永无缺乏常满足;
  
well supply thy sons and daughters, and all fear of want remove.  
2

有此洪流，常能解渴，
谁还觉得不安舒？

Who can faint while such a river ever will their thirst assuage?
2

爱泽永恒，与主一样，
永无穷尽垂千古。

Grace which like the Lord, the giver, never fails from age to age.  
2

仰观上空火柱云柱，
上帝选民蒙引领， 

Round each habitation hovering, 
see the cloud and fire appear
3

依从救主，永效忠贞，
主为祭司主为君。

Jesus, whom their souls rely on,
Makes them kings and priest to God
        3

主若施恩允准我等，
得进圣城蒙光照，
 
Savior, if of Zion’s city
I, through grace, a member am,
        4

纵受世人譭谤讥诬，
也必因主享荣耀; 
 
Let the world deride or pity,
I will glory in thy name
4

至佳福乐，永恒财宝，
惟有主民才明了。

Solid joys and lasting treasure,
None but Zion’s children know
4

199  AH 433聖徒朝覲 Ten Thousand Times Ten Thousand  ()
千万圣徒朝帝阙，衣裳夺目光辉， 
已蒙救赎万方众圣,齐登光明天阶
 
Ten thousand times ten thousand, 
In sparkling raiment bright, 
The armies of the ransomed saints Throng up the steeps of light.

成了，一切都成了！死亡罪恶全摧  
天府金门巍然大开，欢迎战士归来

'Tis finished, all is finished, 
Their fight with death and sin. 
Fling open wide the golden gates, 
And let the victors in.

哈利路亚何热闹，漫天遍地歌声;  
万琴齐奏声似雷鸣，庆祝凯旋已近
  
What rush of hallelujahs. 
Fills all the earth and sky!
 The ringing of a thousand harps       proclaims the triumph high.

此日方知造物旨，为何创造万民！  
此乐足偿千倍代价，从前痛苦艰辛

O day for which creation. 
And all its tribes were made! 
O joy, for all its former woes. 
    A  thousand  folds repaid!

何等热烈乐欢呼，迦南幸福之乡！  
死别生离都成过去，友谊地久天长  

O then what raptured greetings on Canaan's happy shore! What knitting severed friendship where death partings are no more!

恳求赎罪圣羔羊，完成拯救工程;  
恳求充实选民名册，快来执掌权衡 

Bring near Thy great salvation, 
Thou Lamb for sinners slain, 
Fill up the roll of Thine elect,
Then take Thy power and reign!

200   SDAH 422  同往錫安  Marching to Zion ()
凡爱敬主的人， 应当快乐欢腾， 
同心合声赞美祂名，

Come, we that love the Lord,
And let our joys be known;
Join in a song with sweet accord,

同心合声赞美祂名， 
在宝座前颂恩， 
在宝座前颂恩。
Join in a song with sweet accord,
And thus surround the throne,
And thus surround the throne.

大家同心前往锡安
那荣美的上帝圣城

We're marching upward to Zion,
The beautiful city of God.

人未明主的爱， 就必不知感戴， 
但主选民蒙恩前来，

Let those refuse to sing
Who never knew our God;
But children of the heav'nly King,
2

但主选民蒙恩前来， 
赞美主恩万代，
赞美主恩万代。
But children of the heav'nly King
May speak their joys abroad,
May speak their joys abroad.

大家同心前往锡安
那荣美的上帝圣城

We're marching upward to Zion,
The beautiful city of God.

虽未走到天城， 虽未入珍珠门， 
顺从主命快乐万分，

The hill of Zion yields
A thousand sacred sweets
Before we reach the heav'nly fields,
3

顺从主命快乐万分， 
有百福临其身， 有百福临其身。

Before we reach the heav'nly fields
Or walk the golden streets,
Or walk the golden streets.

大家同心前往锡安， 
那荣美的上帝圣城！

We're marching upward to Zion,
The beautiful city of God.

故今日高声唱， 眼泪也都擦干， 
以马内利领我向上，

Then let our songs abound,
And every tear be dry;
We’re marching through Immanuel’s ground               
  4

以马内利领我向上， 
到佳美之天乡， 到佳美之天乡。

We’re marching through Immanuel’s ground
To fairer worlds on high. 
 To fairer world on high.

大家同心前往锡安， 
那荣美的上帝圣城！

We're marching upward to Zion,
The beautiful city of God.

201  SDAH 430    將有大喜樂  Joy By and By   ()
将有喜乐在工完成时，
作工的人 都升天家，

O there'll be joy when the work is done, Joy when the reapers gather home,

世界末日将收禾捆，
到那新耶路撒冷。

Bringing the sheaves at set of sun
 to the New Jerusalem.

乐，乐，那时候有喜乐， 
乐，乐, 那时候唱新歌，
 
Joy, joy, there'll be joy by and by,
Joy, joy,  where the joys never die;

乐，乐，因那日快来到，
工人快要回天家。

 Joy, joy, for the day draweth nigh
When the workers gather home.

我们盼望唱美妙新歌，
心口赞美感谢主恩，

Sweet are the songs that we hope
 to sing, Grateful the thanks our hearts shall bring, 
2

永远颂赞父子圣灵，
在那新耶路撒冷。

Praising forever Christ our King
 in the New Jerusalem.    
2

乐，乐，那时候有喜乐， 
乐，乐  那时候唱新歌，
 
Joy, joy, there'll be joy by and by,
Joy, joy, where the joys never die;

乐，乐，因那日快来到，
工人快要回天家。

Joy, joy, for the day draweth nigh
When the workers gather home.

彼处之乐我将要享受，
天城居所用精金造，

Pure are the joys that await us
 there,
Many the golden mansions fair;
3

耶稣自己现正预备，
在那新耶路撒冷。

Jesus Himself doth them prepare,
        In the New Jerusalem.   
3

乐，乐，那时候有喜乐， 
乐，乐 那时候唱新歌，
 
Joy, joy, there'll be joy by and by,
Joy, joy, where the joys never die;

乐，乐，因那日快来到，
工人快要回天家。

Joy, joy, for the day draweth nigh
When the workers gather home.

202  AH 435   榮耀無比  The Glory Song     ()
当一切劳苦与患难过去， 
安渡过彼岸在天城居住， 

When all my labors and trails are o‘er,
And I am safe on that beautiful shore,

与主耶稣常亲近不离,
那时我所有的荣耀无比,

Just to be near the Lord I adore,
Will through the ages be glory for me.

荣耀无比，荣耀无比， 
荣耀无比， 荣耀无比， 

O that will be
Glory for me, Glory for me,
Glory for me; When by His grace

蒙主大恩典得见祂圣面， 
那时的荣耀，对我真无比。

When by His grace
I shall look on His face
That will be glory, be glory for me.

蒙耶稣救赎无穷的恩赐， 
领我进天国有荣耀无比， 

When, by the gift of His infinite grace,
I am accorded in heaven a place,
2

只要见祂圣面常在那里， 
那时我所有的荣耀无比，

Just to be there and to look on His 
face,
Will through the ages be glory for me.

荣耀无比，荣耀无比， 
荣耀无比，荣耀无比， 

O that will be
Glory for me, Glory for me,
Glory for me;

蒙主大恩典得见祂圣面， 
那时的荣耀，对我真无比。

When by His grace
I shall look on His face
That will be glory, be glory for me.

在天家与亲友永远相聚， 
喜乐如江河涌流永不息， 


Friends will be there I have loved
 long ago;
Joy like a river around me will flow,
3

见到我救主的慈容笑意， 
那时我所有的荣耀无比，

Yet, just a smile form my Savior, 
I know,
Will through the ages be glory for me.

荣耀无比，荣耀无比， 
荣耀无比，荣耀无比， 

O that will be
Glory for me, Glory for me,
Glory for me;

蒙主大恩典得见祂圣面， 
那时的荣耀，对我真无比。

When by His grace
I shall look on His face
That will be glory, be glory for me.

然而圣徒不此是求，
仰望天城万古常留,
  仰望天城万古常留。

But let this thought our spirits cheer, 
We seek a city yet to come;
We seek a city yet to come.

世上城邑并不长久， 
何必因此牵挂心头; 

We’ve no abiding city here, We seek a city out of sight; Zion its name 
2

此世原非圣徒乐地， 
必到天城永无悲愁， 
必到天城永无悲愁。
Zion its name – the Lord is there –
It shines with everlasting light;
It shines with everlasting light.     
2

光明天城永远太平， 
无灾无害无痛无病; 
 
O sweet abode of peace and love,
Where pilgrims, freed from toil, 
are blest!
3

今如旅客行完世途， 
奔向天城安息身心， 
奔向天城安息身心。
Had I the pinions of a dove, I’d fly to thee, and be at rest I’d fly to thee, and be at rest.
3

等到天城降临之际， 
义人永居在此城邑， 
义人永居在此城邑。

While here, to do His will be mine,
And His to fix my time of rest,
And His to fix my time of rest.         
4

204  AH 420   安樂家鄉 Jerusalem, My Happy Home     ()
耶路撒冷安乐家乡此名我心欢喜  世界劳碌何时完结谗能得着安逸
Jerusalem, my happy home,
O how I long for thee!
When will my sorrows have an end,
The joys when shall I see?

那里快乐，实在全备， 
比较伊甸更好;  永无罪孽， 
永无祸患， 永无愁苦烦恼。
The walls are all of precious stone,
Most glorious to behold;
Thy gates are richly set with pearl,
Thy streets are paved with gold.

耶路撒冷，安乐家乡， 
我心欢乐至极;  一到那里，
劳碌了结， 永远得着安逸。
Lord, help us by Thy mighty grace,
To keep in view the prize,
Till Thou dost come to take us home. To that blessed paradise.

205     AH 206 面對面見主 Face to Face   ()

面对面何等安舒！

face to face, what will it be,

when with rapture I behold Him, Jesus Christ, who died 
for me?

如今不能见祂风采
因有云雾阻隔开
Only faintly now I see Him,
      With the darkening veil      between,            2

但愿福日迅速临到
主从天上降下来

在星宿上遥远处，

Far beyond the starry sky;

面对面见主的荣耀， 
到那时心意满足。
Face to face in all His glory
I shall see Him by and by!

主同在时何等快乐，
忧伤皆痛苦消除;  

What rejoicing in His presence,
 When are banished grief and    pain;          3

弯曲道路全都修直，
隐秘之事要显露。 
When the crooked ways are straightened, and the dark 
things shall be plain

面对面我必要见主， 
在星宿上遥远处，
Face to face shall I behold Him, 
Far beyond the starry sky;

面对面见主的荣耀，

I shall see Him by and by!

面对面见我的救主
主认我为他门徒

Face to face  to see and know;

永世无穷与主同居，

Face to face with my Redeemer,
Jesus Christ, who loves me so.

面对面我必要见主， 
在星宿上遥远处，
Face to face shall I behold Him, 
Far beyond the starry sky;

面对面见主的荣耀， 
到那时心意满足。
Face to face in all His glory
I shall see Him by and by!

206  CH 642    將進天鄉 We are Nearing Home        ()
在彼羣山之后便是光明邦，

Lies the Holy City built by God's own hand.

crest, We can view our homeland of eternal rest.

我们快要进去永不再流浪，

There we soon will enter never more
 to roam,

听天使高声唱;

We are nearing home,

美丽圣城遍地铺的是黄金;  

In the roles of the prophets we have long 
been told of that wondrous city with
          its streets of gold.         2

珍珠门户碧玉城墙极晶莹， 
无昼无夜上帝羔羊放光明。
Now with raptured vision we can see 
it there,
 With its walls of jasper and its        mansions fair.  
2

天门大开放射出万丈霞光！

荣耀圣城金玉闪烁极辉煌！  
我们快要进去永不再流浪， 

See the glory streaming through the gates ajar!
There we soon will enter never more
 to roam,

听天使高声唱; 
快要进天乡， 快要进天乡！

Hear the angels singing—
We are nearing home, 
  We are nearing home!

坚守真道热心为主作见证，

Those who enter that city are the chosen few
    Who keep God's commandments
faith of Jesus, too.

决不再游荡，我心向天乡，

228   AH 463 如何能得平安 Peace, Perfect Peace？ ()
邪恶猖狂， 如何能得平安？  
有耶稣宝血， 低声报平安。
Peace, perfect peace, in this dark world of sin?
The blood of Jesus whispers peace within.

世务烦忙， 如何能得平安？  
与耶稣同工， 劳苦亦平安。
Peace, perfect peace, 
by thronging duties pressed?
To do the will of Jesus: this is  rest.
2

忧患交煎， 如何能得平安？  
在耶稣怀中， 我便得平安。
Peace, perfect peace, with loved ones far away?
       In Jesus' keeping we are     safe, and they.  3

亲朋离散， 如何能得平安？  
蒙耶稣照顾， 大家都平安。

Peace, perfect peace, with sorrows surging round?
     On Jesus’ bosom naught but    calm is found.          4

前途黑暗， 如何能得平安？  
随耶稣引领， 到处有平安。

Peace, perfect peace, 
our future all unknown?
    Jesus we know, and He is on    the throne.           5

229  AH 500  用功成聖 Take Time to Be Holy  ()
须用功成圣洁当儆醒祷告， 
常与救主联合并勤学圣道;  

Take time to be holy, speak oft with thy Lord; abide in Him always, and feed on His word.

和信徒多来往要彼此勉励，
凡世俗全丢开当顺主旨意。

Make friends of God's children,
help those who are weak,
forgetting in nothing His blessing 
to seek.

注目仰望耶稣性情自改变， 
使人在我言行得见主圣颜。

By looking to Jesus, 
like Him thou shalt be;
thy friends in thy conduct 
      His likeness shall see.

或欢乐或忧闷顺服主安排;  
要时刻望耶稣信靠主慈爱。

In joy or in sorrow, still follow the Lord,
and, looking to Jesus, still trust 
   in His word.

须用功成圣洁心灵当静谧， 
一切思想动机全归主管理;  
Take time to be holy, 
be calm in thy soul,
each thought and each motive 
  beneath His control.       4

接受圣灵引导得蒙主爱护， 
   准备为主服务升天享永福。

Thus led by His spirit to fountains of love,
thou soon shalt be fitted for service above.

230   AH 484 我需至寶主耶稣  I Need Thee Precious Jesus  ()
我需至宝主耶稣，因为穷困窘迫;  
我无财宝在地上，到处飘流作客。  

I need Thee precious Jesus, for I am very poor; A stranger and 
a pilgrim, 
I have no earthly store.

我甚需要主慈爱，随时安慰我心， 
作我力量与保障，导我无定行程。

I need the love of Jesus to cheer me on my way, To guide my doubting foot steps, to be my strength and stay.

我甚需要主慈心，顾念各样苦难， 
告诉我所有试炼，分负一切忧患。  

I need the heart of Jesus to 
feel each anxious care,
To tell my every trial, 
and all my sorrows share.
2

我甚需要主圣灵，指明我的真相， 
向我表彰主耶稣，引我亲就羔羊。

I need the Holy Spirit to teach me what I am, 
To show me more of Jesus, 
     to point me to the Lamb.

我需至宝主耶稣，深愿早日见主， 
彩虹围绕荣光中，高坐永恒宝座。  

I need Thee precious Jesus, 
I hope to see Thee soon, Encircled with the rainbow, 
and seated on Thy throne.
3

得与赎民长交游，平安欢乐无边， 
不住歌唱赞美主，朝见我主圣颜。

There with Thy blood-bought children, my joy shall ever be 
To sing Thy ceaseless praises,        to gaze, my Lord, on Thee

忽闻人语声，传来我耳畔，
乃主耶稣在呼唤。  

And the voice I hear, falling on my ear, 
The Son of God discloses.

主与我共话，又与我同行，
并亲认我为祂子民，


And He walks with me, 
and He talks with me, 
and He tells me I am His own;

我们在园中两心均欢欣，
更无人领会此情。


And the joy we share as we tarry there,
None other has ever known.

救主声音美妙清新，
林中鸟住声侧耳静听; 
He speaks, and the sound of His voice is so sweet the birds hush their singing, 
2

主仁慈恩言句句入我心，
至今余音犹未泯。 
 
And the melody that He gave to me Within my heart is ringing.        
2

主与我共话，又与我同行，
并亲认我为祂子民，

And He walks with me, 
and He talks with me, 
and He tells me I am His own;

我们在园中两心均欢欣，
更无人领会此情。

And the joy we share as we tarry there,
None other has ever known.

流连园中乐不思返，
日将暮兮云归夕阳残;  

I'd stay in the garden with Him 
Though the night around me be 
falling,  
3

自古欢聚少，那有不散筵，
回忆前情感无限。
  
But He bids me go; through the voice of woe,  
His voice to me is calling.  
3

主与我共话，又与我同行，
并亲认我为祂子民，

And He walks with me,  
and He talks with me, 
And He tells me I am His own;

我们在园中两心均欢欣，
更无人领会此情。

And the joy we share as we tarry there,
None other has ever known.

当我与主亲，便觉无限欢快， 
美逾清晨光彩，愿主同在。

Fairer than morning, lovelier than daylight,
Dawns the sweet consciousness, 
I am with Thee.

与主同在，托庇奇妙荫影中， 
静对大自然，参悟造化工;  
Alone with Thee, amid the mystic shadows,
The solemn hush of nature newly    born;  2

独与主同在，庄严神圣感通， 
朝露晶莹明净，天趣无穷。
Alone with Thee in breathless adoration,
In the calm dew and freshness 
of the morn.

劳苦工完，我灵疲乏睡意生， 
双眼虽困倦，仍仰望天庭， 
Still, still with Thee! As to each newborn morning
A fresh and solemn splendor still 
           is given,               3

在主恩惠中，宵眠甘美安宁， 
醒来主仍相亲，毫无忧惊。

So does this blessed consciousness, awaking,
Breathe each day nearness unto    Thee and heaven.

最后一天，人生阴影尽散开， 
我心灵复苏，见永晨光彩， 
So shall it be at last, in that bright morning,
When the soul waketh and life's    shadows flee;          4

在此快乐日，颂主恩深似海， 
我心永远感觉与主同在。

O in that hour, fairer than daylight dawning,
Shall rise the glorious thought, 
I am with Thee.

倘若踏入错路，或心意动摇， 
求主回头看我，免得我跌倒。

When Thou see'st me waver, 
with a look recall,
Nor, for fear or favor, 
suffer me to fall.

求主使我想起客西马尼园， 
回忆各各他山，我主苦难言。
Bring to my remembrance sad Gethsemane,
 Or, in darker semblance, cross-  crowned Calvary.

倘若主因慈爱，容我遭欺侮， 
或在人生途中，多遇愁与苦， 

Should Thy mercy send me sorrow, toil, and woe,
Or should pain attend me on my    path below,         3

但愿眼不昏朦，能见主恩手， 
将重担托救主，靠主享自由。

Grant that I may never fail Thy hand to see;
Grant that I may ever cast my care on Thee.

世务如云，难扰我心， 
容我与主永恒相接。

O may no earth-born cloud arise 
To hide Thee from Thy servant's eyes.

当我疲倦，睡眼朦胧， 
安眠未熟，心境明通; 
 
When soft the dews of kindly sleep
My weary eyelids gently steep,
2

但愿最后所存思想： 
永远安息，卧主怀中。

Be my last thought how sweet to rest. Forever on my Savior's 
breast.

我若无主，生既无趣;  
我若无主，死亦不安。

Abide with me when night is nigh,
For without Thee I dare not die.

行到前途，爱深似海， 
与主永偕，相契忘形。

Till in the ocean of Thy love
I lose myself in heaven above.

title_en: At First I Prayed for Light

何等权利能将万事,

多少平安屡屡失去，

Oh, what peace we often forfeit; 
Oh, what needless pain we bear

All because we do not carry. 
Everything to God in prayer!

我们有无试探引诱？

Have we trials and temptations?
Is there trouble anywhere?
2

切莫因此灰心失望，
仍当到主面前求！
  
Have we trials and temptations?
Is there trouble anywhere?
2

何处有此忠信朋友，

我们弱点祂都知道，
放心到主面前求。

Jesus knows our every weakness

我们是否软弱多愁，

 Are we weak and heavy laden,

 Take it to the Lord in prayer.

forsake you?

you;
 You will find a solace there.

Thy self reveal.

耶稣，望祢悦纳颂赞与祈求，

of praise; Be in each petition

Then would my hours glide sweet 
Away while leaning on His Word

title_en: Jesus, I My Cross Have Taken

250 SDAH 325 負起十架 Jesus, I My Cross Have Taken ()
耶穌，我已負起十架， 
撇下一切隨主行; 

Jesus, I my cross have taken, 
all to leave and follow Thee.

敬爱救主始终不渝， 
甘受饥寒与困贫。 

All things else I have forsaken, 
Thou from hence my all shall be.

舍弃从前诸般奢望， 
一切所求与所欲;   

Perish every fond ambition, 
all I’ve sought or hoped or known.

主与天国皆为我有， 
我的境遇何富足！

Yet how rich is my condition! 
God and Heaven are still mine 
own.

万一有人加我烦忧， 
更使我与主相亲;

Let the world despise and leave 
me, 
they have left my Savior, too.
2

万一我遇艰难困境， 
更使我多蒙天恩。

Human hearts and looks deceive me; 
Thou art faithful, Thou art true.
2

喜乐若非主所赐予， 
不能使我心欢畅。

O, ‘twere not in joy to charm me, 
   If that love be hid from me.

无论处于何等境遇， 
欣然从主向前行。

Joy to find in every station 
something still to do or bear:
3

救主牺牲将你救赎， 
怎可抱怨在心中。

Think that Jesus died to win thee, 
   child of heaven, canst thou         repine?

当从恩典奔向光荣， 
祈祷为翼信为盾;

Haste then on from grace to glory, armed by faith, and winged by prayer,
4

永生光明照你面前， 
上帝亲手引你行。

Heaven’s eternal day’s before thee,  God’s own hand shall guide thee there.
4

渡过作客苦时光，

Soon shall close thy earthly 
mission, 
soon shall pass thy pilgrim days;

望变欢欣，祷变颂扬， 
信变见主爱永长。

Hope soon change to glad fruition, 
faith to sight, and prayer to praise.

非我，乃主， 表现于行为态度;   
非我，乃主，贯彻思想言语。


Not I, but Christ, in every look and action,
Not I, but Christ, in every thought 
and word.

非我，乃主，背负起辛劳重累;  
非我，乃主，驱除恐惧忧悔。


Not I, but Christ, to lift the weary burden,
Not I, but Christ, to hush away 
all fear. 
           2

Christ, only Christ, for body, soul, 
and spirit,

4

听奉差遣救世人; 
 
Take my feet, and let them be
Swift and beautiful for Thee.
2

使我口中常颂扬,时时尊荣我君王 
时时尊荣我君王。

Take my voice, and let me sing
Always, only, for my King;
  Always, only, for my King.       2

使我嘴唇常讲论：
耶稣救人宝福音; 
 
Take my lips, and let them be
Filled with messages from Thee.
3

虔诚奉献我金银,不为自己留分文 
不为自己留分文。

Take my silver and my gold:
Not a mite would I withhold;
Not a mite would I withhold.     
3

我愿奉献我心灵,作主宝座荣无尽 
作主宝座荣无尽。

Take my heart, it is Thine own,
It shall be Thy royal throne.
 It shall be Thy royal throne.      
4

我愿献上我身心,永远荣耀主圣名 
永远荣耀主圣名。

Take myself, and I will be,
Ever, only, all for Thee.
  Ever, only, all for Thee.       5

主耶稣我爱祢，因祢先爱我， 
为我钉十字架，历尽万般苦; 
 
I love Thee because Thou hast first loved me,
 and purchased my pardon  on  Calvary’s tree;        2

无论苦乐生死，始终必爱祢， 
我一息尚存在，必歌颂不已;   

I’ll love Thee in life, I will love Thee 
’til death,
   And praise Thee as long as Thou        lendest  me breath;        3

title_en: Live Out Thy Life Within Me

slides.content:
254AH316懇主居我心 Live Out Thy Life Within Me()
万王之王主耶稣，恳求永居我心  
我心所存诸疑问，求主为我澄清  

Live out Thy life within me,
 O Jesus, King of kings!
Be Thou Thyself the answer 
To all my questionings;

使我生活效学主，凡事顺主圣命 
我愿献作传光体，表彰我主尊容

Live out Thy life within me, 
In all things have Thy way!
 I, the transparent medium 
Thy glory to display.

罪愆尽蒙主清除，谨献身心为祭  
惟愿真神荣耀光。 藉此彰显公义  

The temple has been yielded, 
and purified of sin;
Let Thy Shekinah glory 
 Now shine forth from within,  
2

世间众生皆默然，我独归主不疑 
终身愿为主忠仆，恭谨遵主旨意

and all the earth keep silence, 
The body henceforth be
Thy silent, gentle servant, 
  Moved only  as by Thee.

四肢百体常准备，恭候我主圣召 
甘愿听凭主使用，自己并无需要

Its members every moment held subject to Thy call,
Ready to have Thee use them, 
Or not be used at all;
3

心无挂虑或烦扰，安然随主引导 
无论何往不怨尤，乐意接受管教

Held without restless longing, 
Or strain, or stress, or fret or 
chafings at Thy dealings, 
    Or thoughts of vain regret.

存心安静而忠顺，决不顾徇私情 
恭听指派不踌躇，随时遵主而行  

But restful, calm, and pliant, 
From bend and bias free,
Awaiting Thy decision, 
When Thou hast need of me.
4

万王之王主耶稣，恳求永居我心  
我心所存诸疑问，望主施恩解明


Live out Thy life within me, 
O Jesus, King of kings!
Be Thou the glorious answer 
      To all my questionings.

255 AH 303在主十架下 Beneath the Cross of Jesus ()
在主耶稣十架下，欢然立定脚跟， 
犹如盛暑远行辛苦,得就磐石庇荫 
Beneath the cross of Jesus
I fain would take my stand, 
the shadow of a mighty rock within
 a weary land;

如在旷野欣逢居处,长途喜见凉亭 
到此得息肩头重担,养力奔赴前程

a home within the wilderness, 
a rest upon the way, 
from the burning of the noontide heat, and the burden of the day.

神圣庄严之十架，我常举目瞻仰 
如见救主宝血倾流，为我舍身之像  

Upon that cross of Jesus mine eye
 at times can see the very dying form 
Of one who suffered there for me;
2

热泪满眶寸心如裂,两事仔细思量 
思量我身不配受恩,思量主爱非常

and from my stricken heart with tears
two wonders I confess:
the wonders of redeeming love
  and my unworthiness.

世界荣华,不足贪图,得失无关重要 
但将罪恶看为羞耻，宝架看为荣耀

content to let the world go by,
to know no gain nor loss,
my sinful self my only shame,
  my glory all the cross.

256 AH 568 願作主囚 Make Me a Captive, Lord ()
我愿作主俘囚，因此真得自由;  
逼我放下手中利剑反能战胜强仇  

Make me a captive, Lord, and then 
I shall be free;
Force me to render up my sword, 
and I shall conqueror be.

当我自逞英豪，一生常闻警号;  
当我被囚于主怀抱,反觉自在逍遥

I sink in life’s alarms when by myself
 I stand; Imprison me within Thine 
arms, and strong shall be my hand.

未曾寻见救主，我心鄙柄萎弱， 
逐流飘荡随风摇动,举措皆无定着  

My heart is weak and poor until it a master find;
It has no spring of action sure, 
it varies with the wind.
2

若欲坚立不移，奋勇与敌争兢， 
必须紧靠救主慈怀,从而寻得生命


It only stands unbent, amid 
the clashing strife,
When on Thy bosom it has leant, 
  and found in Thee its life.

主若常在我身旁，我便奋斗不惧  
 有主随时引我路，安然前进无虑

I shall not fear the battle if Thou art
 by my side, nor wander from the pathway
if Thou wilt be my guide.

我既生存在世间，容我知主相近  
我见迷乱的景物，听见诱惑声音  

O let me feel thee near me!
The world is ever near;
I see the sights that dazzle, 
the tempting sounds I hear; 
2

在我身外与心内，常有仇敌相侵  
 但望耶稣与我亲，将我灵命保存

my foes are ever near me,
around me and within;
but Jesus, draw thou nearer,
  and shield my soul from sin.

耶稣曾向众门徒，谆谆应许相告  
主得荣耀的处所，主仆必能得到  

O Jesus, Thou hast promised to all
 who follow Thee that where
 Thou art in glory
there shall thy servant be.
3

耶稣阿我已许愿，永远服事殷勤  
我主阿我的良友，赐恩使我遵循

And Jesus, I have promised
to serve Thee to the end;
O give me grace to follow,
 my Master and my Friend.

258 慈聲召尋 Weary of Earth   ()
深厌世界，罪担压迫我身， 
一心仰望得进荣耀天庭;  

Weary of earth, and laden with 
my sin,
I look at Heav’n and long to enter in,

虽然邪恶不得进入那地， 
但我耳中却闻慈声召寻。

But there no evil thing may find a home:
And yet I hear a voice that bids me “Come.”

但闻耳中传来美妙佳音： 
“悔罪改过，必蒙饶恕宽宥。”


Yet on mine ears the gracious 
tidings fall:
“Repent, confess, thou shalt be 
loosed from all.”

亲爱救主，使我认清救恩， 
奉献身心，跟从救主而行。

Grant me, dear Lord, Thy saving love 
to see;
I strive no more; I give myself to 
         Thee.

比雪还白，是， 比雪还白， 
求将我洗净， 使我比雪还白。

Whiter than snow, yes, 
whiter than snow;
Now wash me, and
I shall be whiter than snow.

献我身与心，献我所有一切;      求将我洗净，使我比雪还白。

I give up myself, and whatever
 I know;
Now wash me, and I shall be whiter 
than snow.

比雪还白，是， 比雪还白， 
求将我洗净， 使我比雪还白。 

Whiter than snow, yes, 
whiter than snow;
Now wash me, and 
I shall be whiter than snow.

比雪还白，是， 比雪还白， 
求将我洗净， 使我比雪还白。

Whiter than snow, yes, 
whiter than snow;
Now wash me, and 
I shall be whiter than snow.

比雪还白，是， 比雪还白， 
求将我洗净， 使我比雪还白。

Whiter than snow, yes, 
whiter than snow;
Now wash me, and
 I shall be whiter than snow.

260  AH 412 披主義袍 Cover With His Life  ()
仰望我耶稣，无罪救主， 
天父将祂义遮我罪污。  
Look upon Jesus, 
sinless is He;
Father, impute His life unto me.

我罪与忧患，赭红如血， 
披上主义袍，洁白逾雪。

My life of scarlet, my sin and woe,
Cover with His life, whiter than snow.

我罪与忧患，赭红如血， 
披上主义袍，洁白逾雪。

My life of scarlet, my sin and woe,
Cover with His life, whither than snow.

求主护庇我，与我同在。  
律法审判我我亦无碍。

O to be covered, Jesus, 
with Thee,
Safe from the law that now
 judgeth me!

我罪与忧患，赭红如血， 
披上主义袍，洁白逾雪。

My life of scarlet, my sin and woe,
Cover with His life, whither than snow.

主死赎我罪，天人合一， 
因主之纯洁，我得称义;  

Reconciled by His death for my sin,
Justified by His life pure and clean,             3

遵循主教训，可得成圣。  
等主复临时，大有光荣。

Sanctified by obeying His word,
Glorified when returneth my Lord.        
3

我罪与忧患，赭红如血， 
披上主义袍，洁白逾雪。

My life of scarlet, my sin and woe,
Cover with His life, whither than snow.

我愿信心坚，使我得上进， 
我要更加亲近祢。

but I long to rise in the arms of 
faith
and be closer drawn to Thee.

引我更近，更近可爱主， 
到祢十字架面前; 

Draw me nearer, nearer, 
blessed Lord,
to the cross where thou hast died.

引我更近，更近, 更近可爱主， 
到祢流血之身边。

Draw me nearer, nearer, 
nearer, blessed Lord, 
to thy precious, bleeding side.

使我心仰慕， 有坚定指望， 
神旨铭心永记忆。

let my soul look up with a steadfast hope,
and my will be lost in Thine. 
   2

引我更近，更近可爱主， 
到祢十字架面前; 

Draw me nearer, nearer, 
blessed Lord,
to the cross where thou hast died.

引我更近，更近, 更近可爱主， 
到祢流血之身边。

Draw me nearer, nearer, 
nearer, blessed Lord, 
to thy precious, bleeding side.

我心深喜乐，在这好时辰， 
立于宝座之左右; 


O the pure delight of a single hour
that before Thy throne I spend,
 3

当跪下祷告， 就得亲近神， 
与神如同好朋友。

when I kneel in prayer, and with Thee, my God, I commune as 
friend with friend!   
3

引我更近，更近可爱主， 
到祢十字架面前; 

Draw me nearer, nearer, 
blessed Lord,
to the cross where thou hast died.

引我更近，更近, 更近可爱主， 
到祢流血之身边。

Draw me nearer, nearer, 
nearer, blessed Lord, 
to thy precious, bleeding side.

神的乐何高，我不能达到， 
须待我与主同在。

There are heights of joy that I may not reach
Till I rest in peace with Thee. 
4

引我更近，更近可爱主， 
到祢十字架面前; 

Draw me nearer, nearer, 
blessed Lord,
to the cross where thou hast died.

引我更近，更近, 更近可爱主， 
到祢流血之身边。

Draw me nearer, nearer, 
nearer, blessed Lord, 
to thy precious, bleeding side.

262  AH 312 親近十架 Near the Cross ()
耶稣使我靠十架; 因有至宝泉源 
丰盈流自髑髏地，万众灵命保全
Jesus, keep me near the cross; there a precious fountain, free to all, a healing stream, flows from Calvary's mountain.

主十架，主十架，是我所靠所夸， 
直到基督在降临，安息在宝座下。

In the cross, in the cross,
be my glory ever,
till my raptured soul shall find
rest beyond the river.

依靠十架信虽小，救主仍施慈怜 
并有圣灵赐亮光，照我愚昧心田

Near the cross, a trembling soul, love and mercy found me; there the bright and morning star 
sheds its beams around me.
2

主十架，主十架，是我所靠所夸 
直到基督在降临，安息在宝座下

In the cross, in the cross,
be my glory ever, till my raptured soul shall find rest beyond the river.

亲近十架求我主，助我永不忘记  
使我每日行天路，有主亲自护庇  

Near the cross! O Lamb of God, bring its scenes before me; help me walk from day to day with its shadow o'er me. 
3

主十架，主十架，是我所靠所夸 
直到基督在降临，安息在宝座下

In the cross, in the cross, 
be my glory ever,
till my raptured soul shall find
 rest beyond the river.

亲近十架常仰望，靠我主至永远 
直到登彼黄金岸，得逐生平素愿  

Near the cross I'll watch and wait,
hoping, trusting ever, till I reach the golden strand just beyond the river.
4

主十架，主十架，是我所靠所夸 
直到基督在降临，安息在宝座下

In the cross, in the cross, 
be my glory ever,
till my raptured soul shall find
  rest beyond the river.

title_en: the World, But Give Me Jesus

slides.content:
263 AH 329 放棄世界Take the World, But Give Me Jesus  ()
放弃世界得我耶稣,
福与乐全集于主

Take the world, but give me Jesus; 
All its Joys are but a name,

祂的爱始终不变更,
祂的爱永垂万古  

But His love abideth ever,
Through eternal years the 
same.

主的仁慈天高地厚,
主爱心日月长久  

Oh, the height and depth of 
mercy!
Oh, the length and breadth 
of love!

拯救恩典何等全备,
永生福如水长流

Oh, the fullness of redemption,
Pledge of endless life above

放弃世界得我耶稣,
我心灵快乐安舒  

Take the world, but give me Jesus,
Sweetest comfort of my soul;
2

我高声颂扬主爱护,
暴风浪也莫能阻  

With my Savior watching o'er me,
I can sing, though billows roll.
2

主的仁慈天高地厚,
主爱心日月长久  

Oh, the height and depth of mercy!
Oh, the length and breadth of love!

拯救恩典何等全备,
永生福如水长流

Oh, the fullness of redemption,
Pledge of endless life above

在人生旅行之道途,
时刻蒙光照鼓舞   

Then throughout my pilgrim
 journey
Light will cheer me all the while. 
3

主的仁慈天高地厚,
主爱心日月长久  

Oh, the height and depth of mercy!
Oh, the length and breadth of love!

拯救恩典何等全备,
永生福如水长流

Oh, the fullness of redemption,
Pledge of endless life above

放弃世界得我耶稣,
十字架我最仰慕   

Take the world, but give me Jesus;
In His cross my trust shall be,
4

在光明荣耀之乐土,
面对面见我救主   

Till, with clearer, brighter vision
Face to face my Lord I see.  
4

主的仁慈天高地厚,
主爱心日月长久  

Oh, the height and depth of mercy!
Oh, the length and breadth of love!

拯救恩典何等全备,
永生福如水长流

Oh, the fullness of redemption,
Pledge of endless life above

主阿!我愿奉行祢旨意，
从今施扶持。  

I would do Thy will, O Lord, not mine;
Help me, help me now.

全属祢，全属祢，
我今立志全属祢  

Wholly Thine, wholly Thine, 
wholly Thine this is my vow;

全属祢，全属祢，
主阿我今全属祢

Wholly Thine, wholly Thine, 
wholly Thine O Lord, just now.

世上名利富贵有何益， 
若没祢，若没祢？   

What is worldly pleasure, 
wealth or fame,
Without Thee, without Thee?
2

我愿看破尘世万般事,
专心依从祢。   

I will leave them all for Thy dear Name,
 This my wealth shall be       
2

全属祢，全属祢，
我今立志全属祢  

Wholly Thine, wholly Thine, 
wholly Thine this is my vow;

全属祢，全属祢，
主阿我今全属祢

Wholly Thine, wholly Thine, 
wholly Thine O Lord, just now.

在祢面前我将万事足，
身心得安息。  

In Thy presence all in all I find,
‘Tis my comfort here.        
3

全属祢，全属祢，
我今立志全属祢  

Wholly Thine, wholly Thine, 
wholly Thine this is my vow;

全属祢，全属祢，
主阿我今全属祢

Wholly Thine, wholly Thine, 
wholly Thine O Lord, just now.

广阔深奥实难测度，
靠此血泉洗罪.  

Jesus, my Lord, mighty to save, Points to His wounded side.

宝血泉源我今亲见,
投身其中洗我罪愆;

The cleansing stream I see, I see, 
I plunge, and O, it cleanseth me!

说明恶性不再牵连，
全赖祛罪泉源。  

It speaks polluted nature dies, 
Sinks 'neath the cleansing flood. 
2

宝血泉源我今亲见;
投身其中洗我罪愆 


The cleansing stream I see, I see,
I plunge, and O, it cleanseth me!

除我沾污,洗我罪愆,
赞美救主宝血活泉。


O praise the Lord! it cleanseth me,
It cleanseth me, yes, cleanseth me.

我今行走光明天路，
远离世俗罪途， 

I rise to walk in heaven's own
 light,
Above the world and sin;
3

宝血泉源我今亲见,
投身其中洗我罪愆，
 

The cleansing stream I see, I see,
I plunge, and O, it cleanseth me!

除我沾污,洗我罪愆,
赞美救主宝血活泉。


O praise the Lord! it cleanseth me,
It cleanseth me, yes, cleanseth me.

天下人间奇妙之恩，
惟主宝血最佳，
 
Amazing grace! 'tis heaven below
To feel the blood applied,
4

我今所有别无可夸，
惟夸我主十架。 
 
Amazing grace! 'tis heaven below
To feel the blood applied,
4

宝血泉源我今亲见,
投身其中洗我罪愆，
 

The cleansing stream I see, I see,
I plunge, and O, it cleanseth me!

除我沾污,洗我罪愆,
赞美救主宝血活泉。


O praise the Lord! it cleanseth me,
It cleanseth me, yes, cleanseth me.

266 來就聖父 Father, We Come to Thee    ()
父阿，我来就祢，帮助我惟有祢， 
愿祢施恩护庇，今向父求;  

Father, we come to Thee, 
No other help have we;
Thou wilt our refuge be, 
On Thee we call.

若不与祢亲近，罪恶笼罩如云， 
愿祢安慰我，心众生之父。

Earth is but dark and drear
Without Thy presence near; 
Be Thou our comfort here, 
Father of all.

助我胜过仇敌，救我脱离灾祸， 
使我心灵稳妥，凡事忍受;  


Save from our many foes, Save from our earthly woes; Be Thou our soul’s repose in time of need.
    2

心愿蒙主恩护，作祢忠心义仆， 
我或往左往右，领我回转;  

Give us Thy grace divine, 
Seal us forever thine;
Our wayward feet incline from
 sin to flee.
3

时常引导我路，行完今世道途， 
然后在天享福，直到永远。


Oh, guide us, we implore,
Till weary life is o’er, And on a 
brighter shore
             We dwell with Thee    3

title_en: I Am Coming to the Cross

slides.content:
我信靠救主羔羊髑髏地为我死亡  
今俯伏十字架前求救我赦我罪愆

I am trusting, Lord, in Thee.
O thou Lamb of Calvary;
Humbly at Thy cross I bow.
Save me, Jesus, save me now.

罪与恶久居心内常仰望救主恩惠  
喜听主温言安慰:我必定救你脱罪 
Long my heart has sighed for Thee;
Long has evil reigned within;
Jesus sweetly speaks to me:
“I will cleanse you from all sin.”
2

我信靠救主羔羊髑髏地为我死亡  
今俯伏十字架前求救我赦我罪愆

I am trusting, Lord, in Thee.
O thou Lamb of Calvary;
Humbly at Thy cross I bow.
 Save me, Jesus, save me now.

我献上一切所有亲与友时间金钱  
身与心不为己用全归主永不变迁  
Here I give my all to Thee:
Friends and time and earthly store;
Soul and body thine to be,
Wholly Thine forevermore. 
3

我信靠救主羔羊髑髏地为我死亡  
今俯伏十字架前求救我赦我罪愆

I am trusting, Lord, in Thee.
O thou Lamb of Calvary;
Humbly at Thy cross I bow.
Save me, Jesus, save me now.

耶稣来充满心间我纯然在祂里面  
我一切皆得完全颂羔羊荣耀无边  

Jesus comes! He fills my soul!
Perfected in Him I am;
I am every whit made whole:
Glory, glory to the Lamb! 
4

我信靠救主羔羊髑髏地为我死亡  
今俯伏十字架前求救我赦我罪愆

I am trusting, Lord, in Thee.
O thou Lamb of Calvary;
Humbly at Thy cross I bow.
 Save me, Jesus, save me now.

268 AH317領我到髑髅地 Lead Me to Calvary ()
生命的主阿来作王
愿我能荣耀祢  

King of my life, I crown Thee now,
Thine shall the glory be;

使我莫忘祢荆刺冠
