世上福我何必求？  
岂疑惑主耶稣眷佑？

All the way my Savior leads me; 
What have I to ask beside? 
Can I doubt His tender mercy,

降天粮养我灵命。  
行天路虽有时疲倦，
或我心遇有干渴， 

Feeds me with the living bread; 
Though my weary steps may falter, 
And my soul a thirst may be,

我一路蒙救主引导，
想主爱何等高深！  
主应许满足的平安，

All the way my Savior leads me; 
O the fullness of His love! 
Perfect rest to me is promised
3

在天家享受福份。  
等变化我得着荣体，
升天上到光明所， 

In my Father‘s house above;
When I wake to life immortal,
Wing my flight to realms of day,

285  AH 509 稳固根基 How Firm a Foundation ()
主耶稣的门徒有稳固根基， 
即上帝的言语在圣书所记;  
 
How firm a foundation, 
ye saints of the Lord, 
is laid for your faith in His excellent word!

祂所赐的应许是丰厚无比，
凡投入主怀抱，祂必施护庇。

What more can He say than to you
 He hath said, 
To you who for refuge to Jesus hath      fled?

总赐你有力量能站立得住， 
  我全能的膀臂常将你保护。”

I’II strengthen thee, help thee, 
and cause thee to stand,
Upheld by my righteous, omnipotent hand.”

因我与你同在，将苦变成甘， 
  终使你成圣洁，永远得平安。”


for I will be with thee, thy troubles to bless, 
 And sanctify to thee thy deepest         distress.”

要使你被锻练将渣滓除尽，
 在你忍受之后就必成精金。”

the flame shall not hurt thee; I only design  
Thy dross to consume, and thy gold
     to refine.”

邪魔虽然围绕设谋来攻击，
   我决不丢弃他，一定施救拯. ”

That soul, though all hell should endeavor to shake
         I'll never, no never, no never          forsake!”

上帝是我安稳慈航，
助我乘风冲骇浪。  

our helper He amid the flood of
 mortal ills prevailing.

恶魔磐踞世上，仍谋兴波作浪，
猖狂狡猾异常，

For still our ancient foe doth seek to work us woe; His craft and power are great

怒气欲吞万象，
世间惟他猛无双。

and armed with cruel hate, 
on earth is not His equal.

我若但凭自己力量，
深知断难相对抗， 


Did we in our own strength confide,
our striving would be losing,
2

幸有神人护我卫我，
率领信众往前方。  

were not the right man on our side,
the man of God's own choosing.
2

如问此人为谁，乃是天军司令，
又是万有君王，

Dost ask who that may be?
Christ Jesus, it is He;
Lord Sabbath,

自古万民共仰，
耶稣基督名浩荡。

His name from age to age the same, 
and He must win the battle.

魔鬼虽然环绕我身，
向我尽量施侵凌， 

And though this world, with devils filled,
should threaten to undo us,
3

我不惧怕,有主同在,
真理因我能得胜。  


we will not fear, for God hath willed
His truth to triumph through us.
3

日后胜负必分，
主道必使他败崩。

for lo, his doom is sure; 
one little word shall fell him.

圣道权力伟大非常，
远胜世上之列强， 

That word above all earthly powers,
no thanks to them, abideth;

 4

圣灵恩典,为我所有,
因主耶稣在我方。  

the Spirit and the gifts are ours,
thru Him who with us sideth.
 4

真道依然兴旺,
上帝国度万古长。

God's truth abideth still; 
His kingdom is forever.

287 AH 514 生命之主 Lord of Our Life ()
生命之主，救赎我众之神明， 
长夜之星，万国希望之大君， 

Lord of our life, and God of our salvation,
Star of our night, and hope of every nation,

敬求垂听，教会呼吁之声音， 
天上全能神。


Hear and receive Thy church's supplication,
Lord God Almighty.

主能护我，何惧弹雨与枪林？  
敌猛何足惊？

Lord, o'er Thy rock nor death nor hell prevaileth;
      Grant us Thy peace, Lord  
2

求赐和平，待我结束此战争， 
天上享和平。

Grant peace on earth, and, after we have striven, 
  Peace in Thy heaven.               4

291 AH 534  拋碇于靈磐 Will Your Anchor Hold  ()
在人生风暴忽扬起之时， 
在乌云暗雾密布之际， 

Will  your anchor hold in the storms
 of life,
When the clouds unfold their wings 
of strife?

有狂潮怒击，有巨浪冲袭， 
请问你的锚能否支持？


When the strong tides lift, and the cables strain,
Will your anchor drift or firm remain?

我们有巨锚，心灵有靠， 
不怕风雨，也不怕浪涛， 

We have an anchor that keeps the 
soul
Steadfast and sure while the billows roll,

抛碇于灵磐，永不动摇， 
在主爱里面又深而又牢。

Fastened to the Rock which cannot move,
Grounded firm and deep in the Savior's love.

你的锚抛碇在救主里面， 
主圣手必领你渡艰险， 

It is safely moored, ‘twill the storm withstand,
For ’tis well secured by the Savior‘s hand;
2

你与祂的心紧紧地相连， 
主的大能必赐你安全。


And the cables passed from His heart to mine,
 Can defy the blast, through strength               divine.       2

我们有巨锚，心灵有靠， 
不怕风雨，也不怕浪涛， 

We have an anchor that keeps the 
soul
Steadfast and sure while the billows roll,

抛碇于灵磐，永不动摇， 
在主爱里面又深而又牢。

Fastened to the Rock which cannot move,
Grounded firm and deep in the Savior's love.

在惊险海峡我们不忧惧， 
虽暗礁四伏亦必无虞，
 

It will firmly hold in the straits of fear,
When the breakers have told the reef
 is near;
3

虽狂风怒号，虽骇浪四起， 
有主同在可安然无虑。


Though the tempest rave and the wild winds blow,
Not an angry wave shall our bark o‘er      flow.  3

我们有巨锚，心灵有靠， 
不怕风雨，也不怕浪涛， 

We have an anchor that keeps the 
soul
Steadfast and sure while the billows roll,

抛碇于灵磐，永不动摇， 
在主爱里面又深而又牢。

Fastened to the Rock which cannot move,
Grounded firm and deep in the Savior's love.

举目向天望破晓之曙光， 
珍珠之门户何其辉煌！   

It will surely hold in the floods of death,
When the waters cold chill our latest               breath;            4

我的锚稳抛光明之海港， 
狂风与暴浪不再猖狂。

On the rising tide it can never fail,
While our hopes abide within the veil.
4

我们有巨锚，心灵有靠， 
不怕风雨，也不怕浪涛， 

We have an anchor that keeps the 
soul
Steadfast and sure while the billows roll,

抛碇于灵磐，永不动摇， 
在主爱里面又深而又牢。

Fastened to the Rock which cannot move,
Grounded firm and deep in the Savior's love.

罪恶太沉重我的困苦无比， 
万古灵磐石我今藏身于祢。


so sinful, so weary, Thine, Thine, 
would I be;Thou blest “Rock of Ages,” 
I’m hiding in Thee.

藏身于祢，藏身于祢 
万古灵磐石我今藏身于祢。

Hiding in Thee, hiding in Thee,
Thou blest “Rock of Ages,”
I’m hiding in Thee.

生平或顺利或忧愁或危急， 
有时遇试探要我将主丢弃， 


In the calm of the noontide, 
in sorrow’s lone hour, In times when temptation casts over me its power; 
 2

苦海浪滔滔狂风暴雨四起， 
万古灵磐石我今藏身于祢。


In the tempests of life, on its wide, heaving sea, Thou blest 
“Rock of Ages,” I’m hiding in Thee.    
2

藏身于祢，藏身于祢 
万古灵磐石我今藏身于祢。

Hiding in Thee, hiding in Thee,
Thou blest “Rock of Ages,”
I’m hiding in Thee.

仇敌来攻击使我走投无路， 
万古灵磐石荫庇我施救护; 


How oft in the conflict, when pressed by the foe,
I have fled to my refuge and breathed       out my woe;     3

患难如山高又如怒海波涛， 
万古灵磐石我藏身不动摇。


How often, when trials like sea billows roll, Have I hidden in Thee, 
      O Thou Rock of my soul.     3

藏身于祢，藏身于祢， 
万古灵磐石我今藏身于祢。

 Hiding in Thee, hiding in Thee,
Thou blest “Rock of Ages,”
I’m hiding in Thee.

仍然要信主，因祂必保护我;  
主已救赎我，我是祂小孩。

Still I can trust Him; I know He will keep me; He has redeemed me, 
and I am His child.

在主翼下，在主翼下， 
永与主恩爱不隔开;  

Under His wings, under His wings,
Who from His love can sever?

在主翼下，心灵常安泰， 
永远藏身在主怀。

Under His wings, my soul shall abide,
Safely abide forever.

在主翼下，或遇伤心与忧愁， 
在我主里面必得着安泰， 

Under His wings, what a refuge in sorrow!
How the heart yearningly turns to its            rest!               2

虽然在世界无朋友安慰我， 
靠我主耶稣，心灵常自在。

Often when earth has no balm for my healing, There I find comfort, 
  and there I am blest.   2

在主翼下，在主翼下， 
永与主恩爱不隔开;  


Under His wings, under His wings,
Who from His love can sever?

在主翼下，心灵常安泰， 
永远藏身在主怀。

Under His wings, my soul shall abide,
Safely abide forever.

在主翼下，何等喜乐与安泰！  
藏在主怀中患难不为害， 


Under His wings, O what precious enjoyment! There will I hide till life's trials are over; 
3

在主翼下，在主翼下， 
永与主恩爱不隔开;  


Under His wings, under His wings,
Who from His love can sever?

在主翼下，心灵常安泰， 
永远藏身在主怀。

Under His wings, my soul shall abide,
Safely abide forever.

297 AH 527 施恩寶座 From Every Stormy Wind ()
纵然四围狂风怒号， 
罪海波涛汹涌颠簸; 

From every stormy wind that blows, 
From every swelling tide of woes,

我有山寨可避灾祸， 
即在救主施恩宝座。

There is a calm, a sure retreat: 
'Tis found beneath the mercy seat.

有一地方主施拯救， 
用油膏我，赦我罪咎; 

There is a place where Jesus sheds 
The oil of gladness on our heads,         
 2

无处能比此地安乐， 
即主流血施恩宝座。

A place than all besides more sweet; 
It is the blood-bought mercy seat.

信徒在此心灵团契， 
神圣友谊倍加亲密; 

There is a scene where spirits blend, 
Where friend holds fellowship   with friend.     
3

虽然分离心仍联合， 
共同围绕施恩宝座。

Though sundered far, by faith they 
meet 
     Around one common mercy seat.

圣使展翅供我翱翔， 
尘世忧苦再无干妨， 

There, there, on angel's wings we soar, 
And earthly cares molest no more,
4

天国降临，我心拜贺， 
荣耀归与施恩宝座。

And heaven comes down our souls to greet, 
And glory crowns the mercy seat.

倘遇试探惊慌孤寂， 
何处投奔，可得助力？

Ah! whither should we flee for aid, 
When tempted, desolate dismayed?
5

受难圣徒战胜众恶， 
完全依赖施恩宝座。

Or how the hosts of sin defeat, 
Had suffering saints no mercy seat?

祂曾向孩童们说： 
“来就我，”故此我甚爱祂。

And to the children He said, 
“Come to Me,”
 That’s why I love Him so.

左右 故此我甚爱祂。

When I’m tempted and tried,
He is close by my side,
That’s why I love Him so.

主永不丢弃信靠祂的人， 
故此我甚爱祂。

Never will He for a moment forsake,

title_en: Will There Be Any Stars In My Crown

slides.content:
靠救主大恩典人生路已行完，

 When through wonderful grace by my Savior I stand,
 Will there be any stars in

黄昏时夕阳残,全世界大黑暗， 
我冠冕有没有星发光？ 

Will there be any stars, any stars in my crown
When at evening the sun goeth down?

In the strength of the Lord let me labor and pray,
Let me watch as a winner of   souls,      2

主耶稣传嘉奖如浪涛。

That bright stars may be mine in the glorious day,
When His praise like the sea billow rolls.

黄昏时夕阳残,全世界大黑暗， 
我冠冕有没有星发光？ 

Will there be any stars, any stars in my crown
When at evening the sun goeth down?

It would sweeten my bliss in the city of gold,

 in my crown.       3

He that goeth forth with weeping,
Bearing precious seed in love,

不辞辛劳，不畏艰苦， 
上天慈爱满心胸。

Never tiring, never sleeping,
Findeth mercy from above.

天上甘露柔和下降，

 Bright the rays celestial     shine;        2

struggling seaman

the name all-victorious of Jesus extol,

the great congregation His triumph shall sing,

the praises of Jesus the angels proclaim,

我们恭敬拜，岂能报万一！

His right,

all honor and blessing with angels above,

321  AH 582  與主同工  Working O Christ With Thee    ()
我愿与主同工，与主同工， 
我虽软弱有罪， 不配效忠; 

Working, O Christ, with Thee, 
working with Thee,
Unworthy, sinful, weak, 
though we may be;

今将一切献呈，此生惟主是从， 
靠主恩典成功，与主同工。

Our all to Thee we give, 
for Thee alone we live,
And by Thy grace achieve, 
working with Thee.

走遍穷乡僻壤，与主同工， 
来往奔跑匆忙， 与主相同; 

Along the city's waste, 
working with Thee,
Our eager footsteps haste, 
  like Thee to be;              2

使贫苦人有望，被舍弃者重逢， 
使罪人蒙救恩，与主同工。

The poor we gather in,
 the outcasts raise from sin,
And labor souls to win, 
  working with Thee.

我愿竭智尽忠，与主同工， 
与主同甘共苦， 矢志始终; 

Savior, we weary not, 
working with Thee,
As hard as Thine our lot can 
  never be;     3

“我恩典够你用”此应许不落空 
艰苦变成福份， 与主同工。

Our joy and comfort this, 
“Thy grace sufficient is;”
This changes toil to bliss, 
  working with Thee.

我愿为主服务，与主同工， 
直到世界归主， 万邦一统; 

O let us labor on, 
working with Thee,
Till earth to Thee is won, 
  from sin set free;        4

天涯地极各方,向主敬拜歌颂， 
宇宙众生和融，与主同工。

Till men, from shore to shore, receive Thee, and adore,
And join us evermore, 
  working with Thee.

322    宣傳福音 Brothers, Rise, Proclaim the Word    ()
同胞呼救声殷殷！ 基督门徒宜速兴  全国守候主福音，从主导引向前行;  田中金粟届秋成，收获时期今已临， 穑多工少须奋进，捆载输入主天庭。

322    宣傳福音 Brothers, Rise, Proclaim the Word    ()
基督福音速传扬，化遍五岳泛三江， 十架精神爱之谛，消除意见换心肠;  从此干戈化玉帛，协力同济渡汪洋， 待见全球大同日，人类共沐主恩光。

323   AH 597 主的僕人 Ye Servant of the Lord  ()
凡属主的仆人， 当尽各人本份， 
 遵主圣言，安心等候，
儆醒守主之门;           
Ye servants of the Lord,
Each in his office wait,
Observant of His heavenly Word,
And watchful at His gate.

时常收拾你灯， 务要焕发光明;  
腰间束带，如在主前，
表示敬畏之诚;  

Let all your lamps be bright,
And trim the golden flame,
Gird up your loins as in His sight,
His coming thus proclaim. 2

主仆若肯儆醒， 虔诚候主复临， 
那日必能欢然见主， 
获得冠冕尊荣;  

O happy servant, he,
In such a posture found!
He shall His Lord with rapture see,
And be with honor crowned.  4

为何自伤孤零，知音无处寻， 
岂知耶稣慈怀，恩惠最丰盈。

Why should you be lonely, why for friendship sigh,
When the heart of Jesus has a full supply?

耶稣思想之中，念念只为汝， 
温暖犹如日光，甘美若晨露;  
In the mind of Jesus there is thought for you,
Warm as summer sunshine, sweet  as morning dew;     2

为何终日惶惶，焦思多挂虑， 
岂知耶稣赎民，神恩常眷顾。
Why should you be fearful, why take anxious thought,
Since the mind of Jesus cares for    those He bought?

为何怠惰闲懒，妄图丰功就， 
岂知耶稣园地，正待人收割。

Why stand idly sighing for some lifework grand,
While the field of Jesus seeks your  reaping hand?

为何彷徨流荡，厌劳复伤逝， 
岂知耶稣家中，已有你位次。

Why then, like a wanderer, 
roam with weary pace,
If the home of Jesus holds for 
you a place?

随时都要欢欣，手持圣书。 
牧养我主小羊，我甚快乐， 
用爱心去作工就有效果。

作工需要祷告，全心相信; 
获得作工能力，与主亲近。 
我虽精疲力尽，福音广播， 
用爱心去作工就有效果。
2

作工必须殷勤，直到主来; 
光阴似箭过去，不能再回。 
为耶稣去劳力，祂已差我， 
用爱心去作工就有效果。
3

326    克己服務 Do Something for Somebody
我要每日为人克己服务， 
如此行可领人同走天国路，

Do something for somebody ev’ry day, To help them along in the heavenly way;

在生活行为上表扬主道， 
为主作见证使人归荣耶稣。

A “living epistle” are you for God. 
A witness for Jesus the glorified Lord.

Then bring him to Jesus this very hour, His love has redeem’d you, 
go tell of his pow’r.
趁今日吸引他前来就主， 既蒙主救当转作救人工夫。

要每日为别人克己服务，

Do something for somebody
 ev’ry day, 
You may not do much, you can         
        speak, you can pray;       3

Whatever is done for the blessed Lord,
Sometime, t’is his promise, receives a reward.

title_en: O Master, Let Me Walk With Thee

slides.content:
327 AH 574    与主偕行 O Master, Let Me Walk With Thee
求主容我与祢偕行， 自由服务，谦逊忠诚;  求主示我治事秘诀， 
助我能负烦劳艰辛。
O Master, let me walk with Thee
in lowly paths of service free;
tell me thy secret; help me bear
the strain of toil, the fret of care.

求主助我善用爱心， 常以良言感化邻人;  随时随地引领同胞， 
脱离迷津走上天程。
Help me the slow of heart to move
by some clear, winning word of love; teach me the wayward feet to stay, and guide them in the homeward way.  2

求主赐我忍耐恒心， 与主同工，亲密日增， 虔信真理必胜万恶， 
能勇能仁，奋斗前进。
Teach me thy patience; still with Thee in closer, dearer company,
in work that keeps faith sweet and strong, in trust that triumphs over           wrong;    3

求主助我永坚信望， 无限前程，远大光明， 无上平安惟主能赐， 
主啊，容我与祢偕行。
In hope that sends a shining ray
far down the future's broadening way, in peace that only Thou canst give, with thee, O Master, let me live.  4

328     事奉耶稣  The Service of Jesus        ()
真正快乐就是为耶稣服务， 
靠祂最安妥，除净诸罪污 
就是天也靠祂，遵行祂吩咐;  
每天务必事奉耶稣。  
每天值得事奉

耶稣，我爱主， 
事奉救赎主得永福;  
虽然走光明道路,有时也蒙雾， 
但当壮胆快乐奔前途。

务必事奉耶稣不拘何难处， 
不论作什么，须尽力应付，

title_en: The Son Of God Goes Forth To War

slides.content:
334 上帝之子出征 The Son Of God Goes Forth To War    ()

血红大纛飘扬远引谁肯从主出征  

The Son of God goes forth to war
A kingly crown to gain.
His blood-red banner streams afar;
Who follows in His train?

谁能战胜一切艰辛谁能苦杯痛饮 
谁能在世长负十架便是从主之人

Triumphant over pain,
Who patient bears his cross below--
He follows in His train.

殉道先贤独具慧眼看穿肉体坟茔  
仰天瞻望看见救主向祂呼召救拯

Could pierce beyond the grave,
Who saw his Master in the sky
And called on Him to save.
2

像祂一样临死求父饶恕害祂的人  
愿为恶人慈心哀恳谁肯从祂进行

Like Him, with pardon on His tongue,
In midst of mortal pain,
He prayed for them that did the wrong
     Who follows in His train?

光荣队伍少数选民曾经得到圣灵
十二英雄所望分明十架火焰看轻

On whom the Spirit came,
Twelve valiant saints--their hope they knewAnd mocked the cross and flame.

The lion's gory mane;

till sin's fierce war shall cease,
and holiness shall whisper
the sweet amen of peace.

“阿们;”  不藉刀剑屡交锋，

with deeds of love and mercy
 the heavenly kingdom comes.

we follow, not with fears,
for gladness breaks like morning

As Thou has sought, so let me seek
Thine erring children lost and lone.

求主赐我天上吗哪,
使我足以拯困疗饥。

O feed me, Lord, that I may feed
 Thy hungering ones with manna  
sweet.          
2

主乃磐石,作我立场,
求赐力量,使我刚强;  

O strengthen me, that while I stand
Firm on the rock, and strong in Thee,
3

如此方能伸出爱手,
救人脱离苦海狂洋。

I may stretch out a loving hand
To wrestlers with the troubled sea.
3

371  AH 553  耶穌仍引領 Jesus, Still Lead On   ()
耶稣，仍引领，直到平安境， 
虽然道路险阻难行， 

Jesus, still lead on, till our rest be
 won,
And, although the way be cheerless,

我愿随主，安宁无惊;  
求主亲手领，归回父家庭。

We will follow calm and fearless,
Guide us by Thy hand to our fatherland.

倘若路难行，倘若敌人近， 
但愿永无疑惑忧惊，
 

If the way be drear, if the foe be near,
Let no faithless fears o’ertake us,
2

但愿坚守希望信心;  
宁历千万苦，直奔父家庭。


Let not faith and hope forsake us,
For through many a woe to our home we go. 
2

扶助， 安慰，保佑我们， 
直待路行尽， 安抵父家庭。


Still support, control, protect us,
Till we safely stand in our fatherland.
3

372   愿主旨意得成  My Jesus, as Thou Wilt   ()
愿主随意而行，我愿遵主圣命;  
一切交托恩主，不再自为经营。  

My Jesus, as Thou wilt! 
Oh, may Thy will be mine!
Into Thy hand of love
I would my all resign;

任遇忧伤喜乐，惟赖主手导引， 
助我随时欢称： 愿主旨意得成

Through sorrow, or through joy,
Conduct me as Thine own, 
and help me still to say, 
my Lord, Thy will be done!

愿主随意而行，我愿尝受酸辛， 
惟求希望之星，不致昏暗失明。  

My Jesus, as Thou wilt!
Though seen through many a tear,
Let not my star of hope
Grow dim or disappear;
2

救主昔日在世，也曾流泪伤心， 
若须与主同泣，愿主旨意得成。

Since Thou on earth hast wept,
And sorrowed oft alone,
If I must weep with Thee,
   My Lord, Thy will be done!  
2

愿主随意而行，万事必益我身， 
未来境遇多变，靠主欢乐日增。  

My Jesus, as Thou wilt!
All shall be well for me;
Each changing future scene
I gladly trust with Thee.
3

心无尘思俗虑，向前奔行天程， 
或生或死均唱： 愿主旨意得成。

Straight to Thy rest above
I travel calmly on,
And sing, in life or death,
   My Lord, Thy will be done!   3

尘世俗务充塞此心， 
虚度时日百事无成。

The things of earth have filled our thought,
And trifles of the passing hour.

恳赐恩光启明真理， 
并赐智慧认识真神。

Lord, give us light Thy truth to see,
And make us wise in knowing Thee.

我们尚未全心畏主， 
未曾向祂跪拜礼敬; 
 
We have not feared Thee as we ought,
Nor bowed beneath Thine awful eye,
2

言行思想从未谨慎，
忘记上帝即在附近。  

Nor guarded deed and word
and thought,
Remembering that God was nigh
2

恳赐信德悟主临格， 
并赐诚挚敬畏之心。

Lord, give us faith to know Thee near,
    And grant the grace of holy fear.
                   2

冷淡退后远离救主，
不肯追随救主脚步。 

Thy presence we have coldly sought,
And feebly longed Thy face to see.
3

恳赐新心爱主忠诚，
 由衷感戴上帝眷顾。

Lord, give a pure and loving heart
To feel and own the love Thou art.
3

我们尚未全力事主， 
每每轻忽应尽义务， 
We have not served Thee as we ought,
Alas! the duties left undone,
4

视主圣工无足轻重，
屡战屡败获胜无路。
 
The work with little fervor wrought,
The battles lost or scarcely won! 
4

恳赐热诚添我才能， 
为主效劳全力以赴。

Lord, give the zeal, and give the might,
For Thee to toil, for Thee to fight 
      4

但愿我们认清恩主， 
敬畏崇爱克尽本份！  

When shall we know Thee as we ought,
And fear and love and serve aright?
 5

但愿我们早脱试炼，
进入天乡作主圣民！  

When shall we, out of trial brought
Be perfect in the land of light?
5

惟求扶助日日准备， 
得见荣颜欢乐无垠。

Lord, may we day by day prepare
To see Thy face and serve Thee there.
5

四方求主引导 

Lead, kindly Light, amid the 
encircling gloom;

家乡求主引导

See the distant scene
one step enough for me.

        2

彼时我惟任意选途而行，
今求引导，

         2

彼时我爱虚华随意荡游，

I loved the garish day, and, spite of fears, Pride ruled my will. 
    Remember not past years.

主既助我已久何由疑惑，
必仍引导， 
So long Thy pow'r hath blest me, 
sure it still will lead me on
        3

在世险阻引我过死荫谷，
深夜过了， 

O'er moor and fen, o'er crag and torrent, till the night is gone.
        3

晨光一开，圣徒喜容必显， 

And with the morn those angel faces smile, Which I have loved long since,        and lost awhile!      
即我所爱， 暂失而今再见。

晌午炎热求引导我,

In pastures fair Thou feedest me;
I trust Thy love, no want I know.

晌午炎热求引导我,
在磐石旁歇息安详。

At sultry noon thou guidest me,
To rest beside the cooling rock.
2

我喜听从牧人呼唤,

Gladly I hasten at Thy call;

376 更近父家 One Sweetly Solemn Thought ()
甜蜜庄严思想， 几回向我重临;  
今天我比以前时候更加接近家庭

One sweetly solemn thought
Comes to me o’er and o’er;
Nearer to my home today am I
than e’er I’ve been before.

更近天父家庭， 宅第光耀绝伦; 更近洁白荣光宝座更近晶海之滨

Nearer my Father’s house,

求父坚我信心， 使我靠主大能;  
虽到后来临终之际立足依然坚稳

Father, perfect my trust!
Strengthen my power of faith!

         Upon the shore of death.        4

Then my soul shall fear no ill,

and His footsteps follow still.

title_en: Though Men Despise and Friends Revil

slides.content:
383 靠主歌 Though Men Despise and Friends Revile      ()
虽然世俗轻我凌
   我甚至亲友背离，

Tho’ all the world despise, revile,
Tho’ bonds of friendship break

但我记得我主曾说
“我总不离弃你.”

I’ll still recall what my God said
‘My own I’ll not forsake.’

虽然荆棘拦阻前程，
四面仇敌相侵，
 
Tho’ thorns obstruct my way ahead,
Tho’ enemies ensnare,
2

但我深信我主慈爱，
靠主绝不忧惊。

I’ll still believe in my Lord’s’ love
And trusting feel no care.
2

虽然牧场未见青草，
粮食不能得到， 
Tho’ meadows lack their wonted
 grass,
Tho’ I’ve no place to feed,
3

但我有主为我善牧，
我必不致缺少。

The Lord is still my shepherd good
 And He’ll to pastures lead.
3

虽然基立溪水干涸，
乌鸦悲啼饥渴， 
 
Although rock springs are dry within,
Tho’ birds a thirst may cry,
4

但主仍在安慰我说
 “我必使你满足”

My Lord still comforts me and 
says: ‘Your wants I’ll satisfy.’
4

虽然经过饥馑水旱，
靠主应许无患，
 
Although I pass thro’s famine, 
Drought  with Him I’ll fear no ill,
5

坛内之面必不减少，
瓶油也不缺短。

The jar of meal with not give out,
The cruse of oil He’ll fill.
5

赞美我主极大慈恩,
护我经过一生，
 
I hail my Lord’s most gracious love,
Support of all my days.
6

赞美称扬,终身难尽,
颂主至荣至尊。

I’ll laud His name while life shall last,
His glories I will praise.
6

顾不丢弃; 我必领你又救赎你，

I will never thee forsake!

Only all My counsel take,

All things tending to delight,

    For I‘ll never, never leave thee,

      Thro‘ the mist by which ’tis      shrouded,           4

title_en: Our House and Home Are Thine

slides.content:
385   安樂家庭 Our House and Home Are Thine   ()
赖主有家有室， 
快乐，和平，安逸， 
日用所需，蒙主供给， 
感谢称扬不息。

主是坚固之墙， 
拒绝危险惊惶， 
我虽软弱，主有力量， 
使我永远刚强。

2

主是道义之粮， 
灵性所需供养， 
芬芳谷粒，来自天仓， 
维持生命久长。

3

主是永生之爱， 
温柔，甘美，久长， 
在主爱中，家人怡乐， 
友邻欢洽一堂。

4

拜主以敬以恭，
 颂主无尽无终， 
但愿我主时常临格， 
主在众乐融融。

5

386    甜蜜的家 Home Sweet Home  ()
虽令我置身在繁华安乐宫， 
锦衣与玉食， 怎及家乐融融！

Mid Pleasures and palaces though 
I may roam, Be it ever so humble, 
there's no place like home;

我家虽微贱，有上主赐真福， 
我愿永在我那甜蜜家中住

A charm from the sky seems to 
hallow us there, Which, seek thro' the world, is ne'er met with elsewhere.

家，甜蜜的家！ 
虽找遍普天下， 
没一处像我家！

Home, home, sweet, sweet home! 
There's no place like home. 
There's no place like home.

举首望高天，星儿小，月儿明， 
低头思故乡， 兴离愁忆别情; 

I gaze on the moon as I tread the 
drear wild,
And feel that my mother now thinks 
of her child,
 2

title_en: Work For The Night Is Coming (SDAH 375)

slides.content:
阳光渐渐加明亮，我也加倍奋兴

Work when the day grows brighter,
Work in the glowing sun;
Work for the night is coming,
When man's work is done.

赶快工作夜来临，趁着白昼光明 
尽心尽意尽力量，勉励惜分阴 

Work for the night is coming,
Work thro' the sunny noon;
Fill brightest hours with labor,
Rest comes sure and soon.

光阴飞逝难留住，每分须留善行 
赶快工作，夜来临，夜临工将停。

Give every flying minute
Something to keep in store;
Work for the night is coming,
 When man works no more.

一篑功成看此时，虽劳切莫暂停 
赶快工作，夜来临，夜临工便成

Work till the last beam fadeth,
Fadeth to shine no more;
Work while the night is dark'ning,
When man's work is o'er.

title_en: The Dawn of God’s Dear Sabbath

slides.content:

恍若经历溽暑夜，重逢爽朗清晨  

The dawn of God’s dear Sabbath
Breaks o’er the earth again,
As some sweet summer morning
After a night of pain;

又如甘霖与时雨，沛降干旱大地， 
更似荒漠遇棕林，倦旅欣获荫庇。

It comes as cooling showers 
To some exhausted land,
As shade of clustered palm trees
’Mid weary wastes of sand.

我等同献微薄礼，虽已满沾污泥，
却经六日诸劳碌，忠心努力不息，

Lord, we would bring for offering,
Though marred with earthly soil,
Our week of earnest labor,
          Of steady, faithful toil,         2

此乃克己之佳果，表明深厚敬爱，
 亦因圣灵所感动，向主谦恭礼拜。                   

Fair fruits of self denial,
Of strong, deep love to Thee,
Fostered by Thine own Spirit
   In true humility.

我等今将诸罪担，卸在施恩座前， 
同向上主屈膝拜，恳求开恩赦免， 

And, we would bring our burden
Of sinful thought and deed,
In Thy pure presence kneeling,
         From bondage to be freed,      3

圣工至今未完成，心中愁苦难言， 
空负天赐诸禀赋，救灵效微堪怜。

Of sinful thought and deed,
In Thy pure presence kneeling,
From bondage to be freed,

A steadfast faith, and sure,

The pardon that we need;
And then the peace so lasting 
Celestial peace indeed

我愿脱离红尘俗念， 
身心领受灵界之光， 
身心领受灵界之光。

From the low train of mortal toys,
I soar to reach immortal joys,
I soar to reach immortal joys.

罪众欣闻救恩圣道， 
从此归主， 与善为友， 
从此归主，与善为友。

And learn to know and fear the Lord,
And learn to know and fear the Lord.

With all Thy quickening powers;

3

欢度敬虔新造人生， 
欢度敬虔新造人生。

Then shall my soul new life obtain,
Nor Sabbaths be enjoyed in vain,
  Nor Sabbaths be enjoyed in vain.

title_en: A Song of Heaven and Homeland

上天门户似敞开，飘来柔和音波

Like none e'er heard before,

As thro' heav'n's open door:

荣耀诗班同颂赞，环绕圣主宝座

In strains of and love,

Around the throne above.

上帝任天门洞启，传来和美音调

Heard from a land afar-
The song of Heav'n and Homeland,
Thro' doors God leaves ajar!

此歌萦回在我心，恍如梦里真真 
似闻天风逐清流，音韵优美绝伦

Like something heard in dreams-

Of heav'nly winds and streams,

天乡乐歌何清妙，人间几曾听到

love to unite us,

title_en: Conquering Now and Still to Conquer

slides.content:
493靠恩得勝 Conquering Now and Still to Conquer ()
现虽已战胜，仍须要再胜， 
因有一全能之王，

Conquering now and still to conquer, Rideth a King in his might,

身穿灿烂之军装， 
高呼其元帅之尊名，
远闻欢乐声宣扬。
Clad in their brilliant array,
Shouting the name of their Leader, Hear them exultingly say:

战事非以强壮而得胜， 赛跑非以速而赢; 乃是靠主应许之恩， 
专以笃信而得胜。
Not to the strong is the battle,
Not to the swift is the race,
Yet to the true and the faithful
Vict’ry is promised through grace.

现虽已战胜，仍须要再胜， 
谁是此奇妙君王？

Conquering now and still to conquer,
Who is this wonderful King? 
2

既是那一切军队之帅领， 
彼等歌颂其荣光; 
祂是我们的救赎主，
Whence are the armies which He leadeth,
While of His glory they sing?
He is our Lord and Redeemer,

又是神圣之君王， 
彼等如永远之星辰， 
在其国中发光芒。
Savior and Monarch divine;
They are the stars that forever
Bright in His kingdom shall shine.

战事非以强壮而得胜， 赛跑非以速而赢; 乃是靠主应许之恩， 
专以笃信而得胜。

Vict’ry is promised through grace.

Thrones and their scepters all shall perish,

等到战事完全止息，

Faithful and true to the last,

Rest, when their warfare is past.

战事非以强壮而得胜， 赛跑非以速而赢; 乃是靠主应许之恩，
